sources.title: [📚정보] 스킬가속 정리
sources.titleEn: [Info] Skill haste summary
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of game version 1.1.002. Skill haste uses the LoL-style formula: final CD = base CD × 100/(100+haste). Only the root skill cooldown is hasted. Internal delays of multi-stage skills, such as child spawn delays and dash intervals, are not. That is why haste seems to work differently per cookie.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치명 관련 스탯 정리
sources.titleEn: [Info] Crit-related stats summary
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of the crit system. Crit rate above 100% gives tiered crits: 1st/2nd/3rd-degree crits, where the integer part is guaranteed and the fraction is the chance of the next tier. Crit multiplier = 1 + tier × (0.5 + bonus crit dmg). Past 100% effective crit rate, crit damage is worth more per point than crit rate. Sugar-rune max per line is 8% for both crit rate and crit damage.

sources.title: [📚정보] 띄우기 저항 작동 방식 정리
sources.titleEn: [Info] How lift (airborne) resistance works
sources.summaryEn: Lift resistance shortens airborne time; it is not a chance to ignore the lift. Resistances combine multiplicatively, and a skill is cancelled if the cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Base 20% + Pinot Noir 35% = 48%, and adding the Panda Dumpling pet's 20% gives 64%, so a 1 s lift drops to 0.36 s and no longer cancels skills. The OP also gives lift durations for several cookies.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치즈 우유 버프 정리
sources.titleEn: [Info] Cheesecake vs Milk buff interaction
sources.summaryEn: Tested on a Lv.1 GingerBrave with Milk (Lv.100) and Cheesecake (Lv.91). Cheesecake's ATK buff has priority over Milk's: a cookie that gets Cheesecake's buff loses Milk's. Milk buffed by Cheesecake gives a much larger ATK buff, but only to cookies that did not also get Cheesecake's buff. So in conquest you want Cheesecake to buff Milk while the dealers dodge Cheesecake's buff, which the thread treats as a retry-lottery.

sources.title: 장문) 크럼블던전 43G 공략, 우유 위치 컨트롤 팁
sources.titleEn: Long post: Crumble Dungeon 43G guide, controlling Milk's position
sources.summaryEn: Recommended guide by 스미노프TFT (server in the 100s, #1 in power but #4 in the dungeon before a week of testing). Result 43,193,915,016 at 3G 505M, 1st, 4.366 s left, with two roster screenshots. Rules: the top 40 by power fight first and earn nearly all the score; Cheesecake and Lime overwrite Milk's and Macaron's higher buffs, so leave them out; arena gear preset without accuracy or focus, built on Skill Haste, crit damage, crit rate and Skill AMP; Milk captain with Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion at mercenary Lv.4 (Rapid Promotion alone at Lv.3); ATK order Milk > Scorpion > Figure > other dealers, set by lowering levels, with Milk and Figure in the top three; tanks gain nothing from the beam. Supports above Lv.70 made Milk crawl in from the back, so supports stay at Lv.70 or below except Macaron and Milk; Red Pepper and Dark Cherry charge in, get hit, and Milk runs to heal them, reaching the centre at about 53 s. Spend about 1,000 sugar-rune crafts on minor dealers for damage lines. Comments: an app-player trick moved Milk by holding the up key (patched later); cookies outside the 40 join when the 40 die, but at high power everyone is wiped with 8 s left.

sources.title: 마카롱 공증안줘도 되는 이유가
sources.titleEn: Why Macaron doesn't need ATK runes
sources.summaryEn: Milk's ATK buff scales with Milk's own ATK, not the target's. Scorpion ~300k ATK → 1.4M with Milk's buff → 3M if Milk has Cheesecake's buff too. So dealer levels matter little; skill amp is for damage, ATK amp only helps survival/straw targeting. Debate: ATK runes on Macaron are for guaranteeing Pomegranate's straw; alternative is lowering others' levels (e.g., to ~70 at Seeker 6★).

sources.titleEn: [Info] Sugar rune summary (Guild Conquest basis)
sources.summaryEn: Sugar-rune optimizer output from the 65772 calculator for a 12-cookie conquest team where Pomegranate buffs 5 targets. It assumes Macaron, Milk (buffed by Cheesecake), Figure and Ceylon buffs always land. Milk goes all ATK%, Pomegranate all skill amp, and Cheesecake and Figure all skill amp. Macaron and Ceylon get just enough ATK% to enter Pomegranate's top-5, with the rest in skill amp. Dealers that receive Pomegranate's buff go all crit (crit dmg at 10 Macaron stacks, crit rate at 5 or 0 stacks); dealers that don't go all skill amp. The recommended runes roughly double the calculated damage.

Candy Apple disagrees: 2 high move-speed lines (1.05) on Pinot is much better in the Melon deck.

sources.title: 토벌 정전vs허브는 체방 구간마다 다 다름

sources.summaryEn: If everyone dies at 30 s anyway, JW has the higher ceiling. What matters is whether you survive 30→17 s without Herb; Milk sits mid-front and loses 20% HP, dies easily — then Herb scores better since Herb keeps all 12 alive. If you survive 30→17 without Herb, JW is again the ceiling, but JW's longer buff interval and range far from Pomegranate need more retries.

sources.title: [일반] 토벌전 보스 시간 지날수록 피감 늘어남
sources.titleEn: The Guild Conquest boss's damage reduction rises over time
sources.summaryEn: The same author as dc:67285/67299 posts a refined datamine: boss damage reduction runs through 6 stages (10/30/50/70/90/99%) starting at 0% at fight start, upgrading first at 10s elapsed then every 12s after; boss ATK (offense stat) also jumps by orders of magnitude at each of the same stage boundaries. The 99% stage is never reached because the fight is only 60s long. This is the single most load-bearing (if unverified) post for the fight's difficulty curve.

sources.titleEn: Found a way to always push Milk to the front
sources.summaryEn: Removing every backline support/healer (Herb, Rockstar, Lime, Angel, bird-pet-cookie etc, or setting their power to Lv.1 so they can't spawn) forces Milk to charge all the way to melee contact with the boss, because nothing is left behind her to stop the advance. Confirms formation resolves as a straight run-in that stops on first blocking ally/collision, not a scripted stop point; over-optimizing it can wipe the team too early, capping score.

sources.title: (예능) 와레나 언더독 법사덱

It reliably beats equal-power teams and teams 2–3M stronger, and wins most bigger gaps if it survives the first 10 seconds. Early-sweep Bari decks kill it instantly. Strawberry Crepe can be swapped for Ion; Crepe wins more against Moon Rabbit. In the damage charts Wizard does 1.75–2.33M per fight and out-damages everything, beating Brightseeker, Rye, Espresso and Wind Archer decks of 17–21M.

The poster posted the full lineup: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit, with pets Icy Birdie (no Majestic King Choco Drop), Hot Doggie and Holy Baby Drop. Commenters disagree on whether Rye decks still beat it.

Poster says it defends very well; perks 피감 (Armor Repair) + 열정페이. The defense-log screenshot is from Rumble Arena (S-server tags, +125 medals).

sources.title: [일반] 한달마다 TSSR나오고 과금해야한다니 빡세다

sources.summaryEn: To make Bari rather than Cherry Cola receive Pomegranate's buff, you'd strip Cherry Cola's ATK and stack Bari's. The reply: at 5★ you have to give up on the buff.

sources.title: 회피셋 좋네
sources.titleEn: Evasion set is good
sources.summaryEn: With an evasion set (1,005 evasion vs the enemy's 950 accuracy), an 8.41M Rye + Vampire deck beat a 16.53M opponent easily; commenters credit Vampire. It won all 5 revenge fights. The poster runs 스증 스가 피감 회피 and prefers DMG reduction over crit resistance because of Moon Rabbit.

sources.title: 각 프리셋당 옵션 정리글 있음?

sources.summaryEn: Author wants three presets (arena, stage, raid). One commenter: arena = 명중 + 집중; raid = 공격 + 회피. (This conflicts with other posts, where 명중/집중 is the stage set.)

sources.summaryEn: 러너 (a known top player) copies a gallery Rye deck; his 18.77M version won against a 27M Oven/Bari/Brightseeker deck with Rye doing 2.29M. He calls it the best deck without Brightseeker or Bari, with high attack and defense win rates. The formation screen shows the levels, the 'arena/Conquest' preset and the pets.

sources.title: 정보탭 호밀덱 ㄹㅇ좋네

sources.summaryEn: Result screen: Rye 2.26M damage, Seeker 324K, Moon Rabbit 262K; the opponent Rye/Grapevine deck's Rye did only 172K. Comments: give Rye ATK runes so it gets Pomegranate's opening beam; poster gives some ATK so Rye comes after Milk and Seeker in ATK order; SR runes suffice. Cheesecake can be swapped for Crepe.

sources.title: 토벌펫 여전히 판다지??

sources.summaryEn: Four replies unanimously say to use the new pet instead of Panda; it's a strict upgrade and Panda is 'retired'.

sources.title: 체리덱 528배

sources.title: 시커 5성 1t단 입갤
sources.titleEn: Seeker 5★ joins the 1T club
sources.summaryEn: Melon Soda deck (메소/전갈/브시커) reaching ~1T at 1.6G team power (~625x per commenter) with only a 5★ Bright Seeker. Key tech: move-speed (이동속도) sugar-rune lines locked on Pinot Noir, Melon Soda and Seeker to force a formation/ordering that works; he gets correct ordering ~3 of 4 runs, fails by 0.03 speed differences. Jungle Warrior runes are all skill-haste.

sources.title: 토벌 체리덱에서
sources.titleEn: In the raid Cherry deck
sources.summaryEn: Q: why exactly is Cherry in the Cherry deck (some use Melon Soda)? Answers: it's one way to make Seeker receive Macaron's buff well; each cookie included slightly changes starting placement, and Cherry is there to make the formation a straight line. Other says deck choice makes little difference as long as Seeker is buffed.

sources.title: 17초 슬슬 버티네
sources.titleEn: Starting to survive 17 s
sources.summaryEn: The author will take the HP +30% research. Reply: only Milk and Seeker survive, so it isn't worth it yet.

sources.title: 호밀이 좋긴좋네
sources.titleEn: Rye really is good
sources.summaryEn: Removing Wind Archer and Seeker for a Rye single carry gives a much better win rate.

sources.title: [일반] 18초에 애들 죽는데 렙업 시켜야함?
sources.titleEn: Cookies start dying at 18s, should I level them?
sources.summaryEn: Reports that the wipe isn't an instant simultaneous kill exactly at 17s: cookies start getting picked off individually from ~19s remaining, with the last ones going down at the 17s mark. Screenshot (transcribed) shows a mid-fight frame: damage counter 112,876,676,987, a small '18.767' readout near the boss, several dead-cookie portraits (greyed with an hourglass badge) still shown in the bottom bar alongside living ones — dead cookies remain visible in the UI with a distinct 'downed' icon rather than disappearing.

sources.title: 바리공주 오방 체콜덱 개재밌네..
sources.titleEn: The Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck is fun
sources.summaryEn: Three win screens with a Bari (3★ visible)–Oven–Cherry Cola deck (Ion Lv.90). It beat a Rye/Pinot/Hound/Skating Queen deck, a Brightseeker/Wind Archer/Milky Way/Crepe deck and a mirror Bari/Brightseeker/Oven deck. Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola top the damage each time (1.1–2.1M each). The poster says it also beats non-charge decks 3M stronger.

sources.title: 토벌 ㄹㅇ 왜케 안나옴
sources.titleEn: Why is my raid score so low
sources.summaryEn: Cherry-deck screenshot: 72G 82M at 752.83M team power (~96배), 4th personal rank; same 12-cookie layout as 75400 but the Lv.45/90 slot is Lv.1 and one Lv.100 slot is Lv.80. Advice: retry count is the issue; replace 정전 with 허브 if someone dies at 30s; level the others to ~3.5M HP while keeping ATK order. Author says they do survive 30s and use 스증스가 raid gear.

sources.title: 17초 이후 버티는 사람있음?
sources.titleEn: Anyone surviving past 17 s?
sources.summaryEn: One reply gives the minimum condition for surviving the 17 s wipe as 9M HP and 45% damage reduction. Another says it is possible but not a damage gain yet.

sources.title: [일반] 석류 씨발련아
sources.titleEn: Damn you, Pomegranate
sources.summaryEn: OP complains Pomegranate (a pure buffer who should stay at the back) keeps charging forward and wrecking the formation; a commenter's fix is to strip all move-speed stats and rebuild as a full Cherry-deck.

sources.title: 뉴비 토벌전 17배 나오는데 이정도면 어떤수준임?
sources.titleEn: Newbie getting 17x in raid — what level is that?
sources.summaryEn: Newbie at 22M power scores ~380M (~17배) copying the raid deck with 전갈/피노/정글 at Lv.1; Seeker 6★, cannot survive to 17s. Replies: 15x+ is good at that power; surviving to 17s and Seeker 5★+ matter; survival comes from gear and 돌파력 research raising DEF/HP/DR.

sources.title: [일반] 명중 거르고 투력 올렸더니 드디어 G단위갔다
sources.titleEn: Skipped accuracy for power and reached 1G
sources.summaryEn: Choosing raw-power gear over accuracy after the easing took the poster over 1G; stages became easy enough that one accuracy line auto-clears GingerCraven.

sources.title: 17초 이후에 피겨랑 2마리 더 사는데
sources.titleEn: 피겨 and two more survive past 17 s
sources.summaryEn: At ~2.7G (levels excluded) 피겨 + 2 others survive past 17 s; asks how to reach 1T with cherry deck. Reply: infinite retries.

sources.title: 체리덱 580배
sources.titleEn: Cherry deck 580x
sources.summaryEn: 981G 118M at 1.69G (580x) with the 71135 cherry setup, just more sugar-rune polish and spec-ups. Seeker runes changed from all-haste to mostly haste plus a little skill amp/crit dmg. ~1 in 5 manual runs hits 500x; author estimates the true ceiling ≈ your ~20-run best + 10–20%.

sources.title: 이속 기록
sources.titleEn: Move-speed record (rune screenshots)
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple's repost of the Melon-deck move-speed runes. Jungle Warrior: SSR haste +5, SR +2, SR +3 locked. Pinot: locked move speed C +0.26, R +0.57 (plus unlocked U +0.32). Melon Soda: locked R +0.51, C +0.20. Bright Seeker (5★, only 3 rune slots unlocked): SSR haste +5, SSR haste +4, U move speed +0.32. Perks still 열정페이 + 초고속승진. When Pomegranate breaks the line, just retry. A commenter infers final speeds Pinot 4.65 / Melon 4.71 / Seeker 3.82 (unconfirmed).

sources.title: 토벌 기갱 263g
sources.titleEn: Raid new record 263G
sources.summaryEn: Cherry-deck layout, 263G 471M personal (rank 1 in guild) at 1.19G team power (~221배), up from 190G. ATK order given: 우 브 피 실 마 치 전. Commenters: with retries 500G+; someone with Seeker 7★ and 900M power got 350G after ~100 runs; another says that spec can reach 700G; 'up to 400 is reachable, beyond that only if you grind like a log'.

sources.summaryEn: The info-tab Rye deck can't beat Bari + Cherry Cola. Replies: Grapevine instead of Seeker is stronger; in regular Arena few use Bari so it's fine.

sources.summaryEn: Without the Charge buff, a commenter says Rye would kill everything. Another says Rye can't be countered by a Charles deck or 색동 (Candy Shade Pouch).

sources.titleEn: Deciding how to do Bright Seeker's sugar rune
sources.summaryEn: Pre-10★ Bright Seeker rune with 6 active lines (3 스가, 1 스증, 2 치피) and 2 lines locked until ★10. Author considers rerolling both 치피 into 스가. Replies: all-스가 is the standard ('국룰'); skill stacks; one dissent '10성기준 스가4 스증6 정배'.

sources.titleEn: Why does focus count so much for power?
sources.summaryEn: With 1,100 accuracy and 1,200 focus, swapping an accuracy line for focus still adds 7M power.

sources.title: 토벌전 30초꽝 못버티면 무슨 조합 들고가야해?
sources.titleEn: What comp if I can't survive the 30-second slam?
sources.summaryEn: Author fears the Lv.1 strategy won't work without surviving the 30s slam. Reply: just use the 정전 Cherry deck anyway — commenter's alt at 200M power got 6G even with everyone dying at the 30s slam, with 전갈 and 피노 both Lv.1. Another: drop 정전, add 허브.

sources.title: 아레나 호밀덱 카운터 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: What counters the Arena Rye deck?
sources.summaryEn: Poster loses to Rye even with Bari and Moon Rabbit. Answers: a stronger Rye; a deck with Cherry Cola, Bari and Oven wins when it deletes Rye in one go.

sources.title: 와레나 1등 보아라 !!!!
sources.titleEn: Look at the world-arena #1
sources.summaryEn: A world-arena match screen with the names blurred; the poster is 3rd at 25.35M. A commenter unmasks the players as 'ㄹㄹ노아' and 타미 (Carpediem, conquest #4). The strongest opponent is about 30M. Arena only.

sources.title: 어제오늘 쌔빠지게 뚫어서 이면 도착햇는데
sources.titleEn: Grinded through to the Other Side (이면)
sources.summaryEn: The 차원의 이면 dungeon's bonus stats apply only inside that dungeon, not to raid; its pet gives 50% 이면-boss damage. Image: 차원의 힘 level effects (ATK/DEF/HP +10%, crit dmg +30%, crit rate +10%, focus +5%, accuracy +10%, all '차원의 이면' only). Author cleared at ~4.2G team power.

sources.title: 아레나 바리덱 유행하는데 카운터없음?
sources.titleEn: Bari deck is trending; any counter?
sources.summaryEn: Answers: Rye one-carry deck. One suggests a Rapid Fire deck with Donut King and Adventurer so Oven can't do anything. One says Bari decks are oddly weak to 3-tank Rye.

sources.title: 장비 프리셋생기고 너무 어려운데 내 판단 맞는지 조언 부탁해!
sources.titleEn: Gear presets are confusing — is my plan right?
sources.summaryEn: Author plans stage/arena/raid presets: stage = 명중/집중 line, arena = 스가/스증/피감, raid = 회피/스증/피감. Replies: 전투력 only matters for stage; one commenter isn't sure a raid preset is needed at all and gives a per-slot arena layout (top-left 스증+치확, bottom-left 피감+치저, top-right 스증+스가, bottom-right 스가 + 치저/피감) and stage accuracy/focus ~1000/1100.

sources.title: 와레나 바리 필수급임?
sources.titleEn: Is Bari essential in Rumble?
sources.summaryEn: Reply: you need about Oven 7★ and Bari 5★ to hold your own in Arena, and without Bari you skip Oven too.

sources.title: 토벌전 장비 프리셋 치확vs치피
sources.titleEn: Raid gear preset: crit rate vs crit damage
sources.summaryEn: Author: top-right 스가+스증; top-left is it 스증+치확 (arena) and 스증+치피 (raid)? Replies: just take higher 스증; another says the opposite — raid doesn't use 치피, only 치확, with 스증 main; a third notes 치피 is bad in arena due to 치저.

sources.title: 메소정전 토벌덱 전갈이 영원히 마카롱을 못받으면

sources.titleEn: Newbie guide part 1 [Stages]

sources.summaryEn: The Rift's rewards give no lasting power growth; sugar runes are the scarce material (38,000 Rune Crystals from the Rift feel small when good lines take hundreds of thousands).

sources.title: 아레나 호밀덱 이거 맞냐

sources.summaryEn: Confirms the Seeker version lineup: Macaron, Rye, Pinot Noir, Brightseeker, Donut, Moon Rabbit, Ion, Hound, Pomegranate, Milk, Cheesecake, Herb. Pets: Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop, Chargemellow; one user runs Hot Doggie instead of Chargemellow with 4 ATK lines on Rye.

sources.title: 바리 보니까 브시커는 걍 딜러1 이였네
sources.titleEn: Seeing Bari, Bright Seeker was just 'dealer #1'
sources.summaryEn: Opinion that Princess Bari is even more broken than Bright Seeker, except in Crumble/raid where control issues make her troll. Commenter calls her 오방's 'wheelchair' (enables 오방).

sources.title: 바리 없으면 꼬운 수준임? 필수야?
sources.titleEn: Is Bari mandatory?
sources.summaryEn: Mixed views. One side: Bari is broken in Arena too, 5★ is enough and 10★ is for arena bullies, and she must receive Pomegranate's buff. The other side: not mandatory like Brightseeker, and she'll be benched once the Rumble Charge buff goes.

sources.title: 와 근데 와레나 버프 2개였네
sources.titleEn: Rumble has two buffs
sources.summaryEn: Confirms the two buffs: Charge HP +30% and 30% DMG reduction for all cookies.

sources.title: 와레나 티켓 원래 5장임??
sources.titleEn: Is the Rumble ticket cap 5?
sources.summaryEn: The challenge button shows 5/8 tickets. A reply says the real maximum is 5 and the 8 is the bug.

sources.title: 아레나 포도 대신에 락스타도 ㄱㅊ한거같은데?
sources.titleEn: Rockstar instead of Grapevine seems fine in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Tests the Rye deck with Rockstar in the Grapevine slot. Rockstar's recent skill-ready (스킬준비) buff makes its shield land during Bari's first dive. Screenshots: Rumble attack at 13.27M vs 16.72M Bari–Oven, and three regular Arena (시즌5 아레나) fights, including a win at 13.27M against the server's #2 (20.4M) running Brightseeker/Oven/Bari/Cherry Cola, where Rye did 2.21M damage. Long thread on why Regular Arena Bari burst is harder to survive than Rumble.

sources.title: [일반] 차원의 이면 전섭 11등으로 진입

sources.title: 걍 뭔가 와레나 점수 올리기가 쉬운데?
sources.titleEn: Climbing Rumble is easy?
sources.summaryEn: Keep three attack presets and pick by matchup: the Rye deck beats Bari decks, the Crepe–Espresso deck beats Rye decks, and the Bari deck beats Crepe–Espresso decks. The Crepe–Espresso deck is the old '5-Ranged perk' deck: Crepe, Espresso, Rye, Pure Vanilla (바궁), Milky Way, Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Pinot, Doughnut King, Hound, Ion.

sources.titleEn: If you're serious about arena, ATK% runes on Macaron
sources.summaryEn: Explains ATK-order routing in a Rye deck: Macaron, Rye, Brightseeker (or Milky Way), Doughnut King, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Hound. The top three by ATK must be Milk > Rye ≥ Pomegranate so Pomegranate's buff lands on Rye. Hound should out-ATK Milky Way so Macaron's crit buff routes correctly and everything funnels to Rye. A variant against Bari drops Wind Archer and Brightseeker for Moon Rabbit and Grapevine. A commenter's Bari deck deleted this old ranker deck in about 1 s in Rumble.

Lineup: Macaron, Donut, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Rye, Pinot Noir, Vampire, Hound, Crepe, Moon Rabbit (the image shows Moon Rabbit). Pets Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie, Cheese Drop. Wishlist with 5★ Bari: Macaron, Bari, Vampire, Cherry Cola, Peach, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Pinot, Crepe, Moon Rabbit.

sources.titleEn: Why do Rumble rankers use stage sets, not arena sets?
sources.summaryEn: Observation that Rumble rankers appear to use their stage (accuracy) gear preset. 76490 says the same; a reply suggests it's to counter evasion decks.

sources.title: 체리덱 641배 찍었음
sources.titleEn: Cherry deck hit 641x
sources.summaryEn: Cherry deck: 1T 116G at 1.74G team power (641배), guild rank 1. ATK order 우유 브시 피겨 카롱 실론 치케 전갈; 4 Lv.1 cookies (체리 닼초 피노 정전) and 전갈 raised to Lv.45 deliberately so Pomegranate's straw goes to Scorpion rather than Dark Choco when Ceylon misses Milk's buff. Pets 와사비문어/핫도그/색동주머니 all ★20. Gear: 스가 6 + 스증 6, rest crit/crit dmg, spare slots DR; no move speed anywhere; team wipes at 17s; ~1T once or twice per 10 runs, occasionally 1.1T.

sources.title: 회피 해골물 맞음?
sources.titleEn: Is evasion a dead end?
sources.summaryEn: The poster runs the Bari–Oven charge deck (돌장연) with evasion gear, about 1,350 evasion in battle at 15.5M. He takes no damage at equal power and beats +2–3M. Replies: accuracy of about 1,000–1,050 is typical (bow at +15–21), top players use +20 bows, and many carry one accuracy line. Evasion is better on attack presets than on defense.

sources.title: 토벌 시커 7성인데 슈가룬 올 스가 주는게 맞냐?
sources.titleEn: Seeker 7★ for raid — all haste on sugar rune?
sources.summaryEn: Question from 340 (Seeker 7★) whether to go all-스가 on the rune; single reply 'go' (ㄱㄱ).

sources.title: 기갱했다요
sources.titleEn: Renewed my record
sources.summaryEn: Result screen 1,617,831,110,058 (1.62T), '~600x of power' (→ ~2.7G), guild rank 1 with 14T 849G guild total. Seeker 10★, only 4 haste lines on Seeker, 색동주머니 pet, no move speed.

sources.title: 근데 바리덱 같은 체급 호밀덱한테 그냥 개썰리던데
sources.titleEn: Bari decks get shredded by same-power Rye decks
sources.summaryEn: Poster wiped all the 5★ Bari decks on his server with Rye. One reply says they have never lost to the same weight class after switching to Bari. Another notes regular Arena has no charger buff (Rumble does).

sources.title: 근데 호밀덱이 바리덱 잡는단건 어디서 나온 말임
sources.titleEn: Where did 'Rye beats Bari' come from?
sources.summaryEn: Poster's defense logs (Rumble: S-server tags, +125 medals) show his Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck holding against several Rye decks of similar or higher power. Replies: the Oven's fire at the start ends it; others say it's settings, and they have seen Rye beat 7★ Bari.

sources.title: 와레나에선 당연히 접대받는데 바리덱이 쎄지
sources.titleEn: Of course Bari is strong in Rumble, it's pampered
sources.summaryEn: Bari decks are strong in Rumble because of the Charge buff, but not to the same degree in regular Arena, where Rye decks have the matchup edge unless spec is overwhelming.

sources.title: 토벌 장비 골라주라 치확 치피때문에 고민임..
sources.titleEn: Pick my raid gear — torn on crit rate vs crit dmg
sources.summaryEn: Weapon comparison for raid: Lv95 wand with 스증 7.52% + 치피 13.63% vs Lv100 wand with 치확 16.39% + 스증 9.13%. Single reply: definitely right one (higher 스증, 치확).

sources.title: 갠적으로 이덱이 스테 오토 제일 괜찮은듯
sources.titleEn: Personally this deck is the best for stage auto
sources.summaryEn: Stage (not raid) auto deck share. Pinot Noir kept low level deliberately so it does not take Pomegranate's buff; starting buff recipients 호밀/우유/딸크. Perks: armor special + 열정페이. Not raid-specific.

sources.title: 내 장비 프리셋 목록
sources.titleEn: My gear preset list
sources.summaryEn: Preset names (image): '35%(명중집중)' for stage, '아레나(전투+치감)', '토벌전(스가세팅)', '쓰레기통' (dump for auto-sell by power), and a joke empty slot. Commenter afrehh runs 5: 스테(뻥툴), 토벌, 아레나1(정석), 아레나2(회피), 아레나3(명중) because arena is rock-paper-scissors.

sources.title: 바리덱 단순히 체퍼30때문에 쌘건 아닌데
sources.titleEn: The Bari deck isn't strong just because of 30% HP
sources.summaryEn: Cherry Cola, Oven and Bari dive together and delete an equal-power team in about 3.5 seconds, around 2M damage each. One side says a defensive deck that survives one tick wins; another says Ion and Rockstar shields after their skill-ready buff sometimes stop the instant kill, making it a luck contest of Ion/Rockstar/Donut procs. One user says at similar spec the Rye one-carry deck crushes it.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 토벌 투력 몇쯤돼야 30초에 안뒤짐?
sources.titleEn: What power is needed to not die at 30s?
sources.summaryEn: Gives a rough power-to-30s-survival curve from two independent commenters: ~400M power survives with 1-2 cookies, ~600M survives with the whole team, ~1.5G power comfortably never dies at 30s.

sources.title: 근데 와레나도 바리덱이 호밀한테 개털리는거 맞음?
sources.titleEn: Do Bari decks really get wrecked by Rye in Rumble too?
sources.summaryEn: The gallery says Rye + Ion + Rockstar wrecks Bari, yet no top Rumble player (SR all 10★) uses a Rye defense. Consensus in the replies: Rye is stronger at mid-to-upper spec, but Bari decks win at whale top-end. Against max-spec Bari, the buffed divers ('빨대 맞고 쳐들어오는 근숭이') kill everything on contact. At mid spec, Grapevine healing gets a window and Rye turns the fight.

sources.title: 아레나 치확치피 vs 치피스증
sources.titleEn: Crit rate+DMG vs crit DMG+Skill AMP
sources.summaryEn: Nothing beats Skill AMP; crit rate+Skill AMP best; in Arena think about Moon Rabbit (crit rate reduction), so crit rate for Arena and crit DMG for Conquest.

sources.title: 토벌 치확이 필요함?
sources.titleEn: Is crit rate needed in raid?
sources.summaryEn: Author: boss has no crit res so is crit rate needed? Answers: crit rate above 100% keeps adding — every 100% of crit rate adds another crit-damage instance (200% = crits twice; 198% = one crit plus 98% chance of a second). So crit rate is 'more is better'; one says always double crit rate (치확 둘둘). Unresolved whether 치확 or 치피 is better when forced to choose.

sources.title: 아레나 이덱 줘패고싶은데 방법좀 아시는분(제발)
sources.titleEn: How do I beat this Arena deck?
sources.summaryEn: Screenshot of a Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola defense that keeps beating the poster at equal power; its pets are Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie, King Choco Drop, all max. The key difference spotted: the opponent's Milk captain is merc level 4, unlocking Armor Repair (DR 10%) and Passion Pay. Advice: Rye + Rockstar in theory; if still marginal, swap Choco Drop for Icy Birdie.

sources.title: [✋️질문] 바리 스테 구리다는거 바없찐들 연막이냐?
sources.titleEn: Is 'Bari is bad in stages' a smokescreen by people without Bari?

sources.title: 토벌 장비추천좀
sources.titleEn: Raid gear recommendation please
sources.summaryEn: 340 set weapons all to 스증+치피 and compares Lv98 wand (스증 7.47% + 치피 14.53%) vs Lv103 wand (치확 16.51% + 스증 8.00%). Replies favour the latter: 1.4 crit rate ≈ 1 crit dmg in value, but higher 스증 always wins; aim for +15 pieces with 치확/치피 20%+ and 스증 9%+. 340 notes their arena set (치확) scored lower in raid than the raid set (치피).

sources.title: [일반] 이면 9단 씹
sources.titleEn: Rift level 9 sucks

sources.titleEn: What team power do 1T raiders have?
sources.summaryEn: People scoring 1T in raid have ~2G team power per one comment; 저장용 (the 641배 author) is at 1.77G with the full level list: 우유 브시 피겨 카롱 실론 치케 석류 at Lv.100, 전갈 Lv.10, 체리 닼초 피노 정전 Lv.1; pets 와사비문어 핫도그 색동주머니.

sources.title: 바리 슈가룬 뭐줌?
sources.titleEn: What sugar runes for Bari?
sources.summaryEn: Advice: Skill Haste + DR; about 45 skill haste keeps the aura up permanently. Skill AMP doesn't raise the DR buff but may raise aura damage; alternatively ATK so Bari catches Pomegranate's beam.

sources.title: [일반] 바리 스테덱 국룰 나왓음?
sources.titleEn: Is there a standard Bari stage deck yet?

sources.title: 크럼블던전 존나 이상하네
sources.titleEn: Crumble Dungeon is weird
sources.summaryEn: At 4.2G total power the poster's best is 45G but runs now land at 25G plus or minus 2G; reply: Milk must have arrived early that time.

sources.title: 아레나 프리셋이 더 잘미네 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: The Arena preset clears stages better
sources.summaryEn: At stage 290 the arena preset (1G 900M, Skill AMP/Skill Haste) clears better than the stage preset (2G 100M, accuracy/focus). Many agree 6 Skill Haste beats accuracy/focus at the 35% power cut.

sources.title: 아레나 유행 반영 빠르네 ㅋㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: Arena copies trends fast
sources.summaryEn: After the poster hit people with the Rye one-carry deck, they copied it within a meal. Reply lays out a rock-paper-scissors: counter Rye with Crepe + Espresso (Crepe counters Moon Rabbit's 떡방아 by knocking back, Espresso's black hole launches Rye from behind); if they copy Crepe–Espresso, counter with Bari. Another server's top ranks run Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola.

sources.title: [일반] 노쇳물 12강 할만함?
sources.titleEn: Plating to 12 without Syrup?
sources.summaryEn: Plating without Syrup Metal is fine to 12–13 (some say 15). A 1.6G player: one plate level adds about 8M, and 14→15 adds 20–30M, so a few levels add 30–40M.

sources.title: 토벌전 딜량 복사 진짜 있는거였구나
sources.titleEn: So the raid damage 'copy' is real
sources.summaryEn: The author, usually around 15×, once got ~80× and can't reproduce it. They call the lucky spike '점수 복사' (score copy) and say this is why people hunt for the right 'world-line'. A reply mentions running macros. It's RNG slang, not a shown exploit.

sources.title: 바리덱을 잡는 호밀덱을 잡는 카운터덱 있을까..?
sources.titleEn: A counter to the Rye deck that beats Bari?
sources.summaryEn: Answer: Crepe–Espresso beats the Rye deck but is weak to charge decks.

sources.title: 딸크에소가 호밀 잡는다고?
sources.titleEn: Crepe–Espresso beats Rye?
sources.summaryEn: Doubt: one Moon Rabbit ground-slam cripples Espresso. Answer: if Crepe pushes first, the debuff doesn't land; put Moon Rabbit in the Crepe–Espresso deck too, push in, avoid Milk being debuffed, and the buffs roll.

sources.title: 아레나 치케투입+피노누아 있는데 허브 계륵아님?
sources.titleEn: With Cheesecake and Pinot Noir, is Herb dead weight?
sources.summaryEn: Poster's 12.92M 'bullet-cut' deck (Macaron, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Brightseeker, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Moon Rabbit; pets King Choco Drop 20, Hot Doggie 19, Holy Baby 19) asks about replacing Herb with a back-line ranged dealer. Replies: without Herb, Milk can't self-heal and dies alone; running Milk + Herb + Ion is what stops the one-shot.

sources.title: 아니 그래서 딸크에소덱이 뭔데
sources.titleEn: So what is the Crepe–Espresso deck?
sources.summaryEn: Only a guessed lineup: Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Crepe, Espresso, Moon Rabbit, Ion, Donut, Herb, Hound, then Rye and Cheesecake.

sources.title: 토벌 딜 기준 슈가룬 우선순위 누구임?
sources.titleEn: For raid damage, whose sugar rune is top priority?
sources.summaryEn: Asks which SSR sugar-rune upgrade matters most for raid damage: Milk ATK line, Bright Seeker skill-haste line, or Pomegranate skill-amp line. Image is a 룬결정 던전 (stage 469) reward screen showing SSR 석류맛 쿠키 and SSR 전갈맛 쿠키 pulls. No answers.

sources.title: [일반] 15퍼 밀리는건 뭐지요
sources.titleEn: Why is 15% pushing?

sources.title: 동투력일때 호밀덱이 썰리면 문제있는거지?
sources.titleEn: If Rye loses at equal power, is something wrong?
sources.summaryEn: Poster runs the 74483 deck at 19-20M and gets sliced by Bari at equal power before heals and shields go off. Replies: Bari and Oven star levels matter; gear difference; the Rye deck needs 6 skill-haste lines; 'whoever loses Milk or Bari first loses'; with Seeker added Rye's position suffers.

sources.title: 딱히 없는 것 같아서 메모해놓는 스테/아레나/토벌 장비 옵션 (조언요)
sources.titleEn: Memo of stage/arena/raid gear substats (advice wanted)
sources.summaryEn: Author's tentative gear-substat memo per item group for stage, arena and raid (weapons 검/활/지팡이, armor 투구/갑옷/방패, accessories 목걸이/반지/브로치, objects 마법물체/책/음식). The one commenter gives a cleaner per-slot table: raid = top-left 스증치피, top-right 스가스증, bottom-left 피감체력, bottom-right 스가피감.

sources.title: 그래서 호밀덱 무슨버전이 제일 좋음?
sources.titleEn: So which Rye deck version is best?
sources.summaryEn: Lists the circulating Rye deck versions: Grapevine+Skating, Seeker+Donut, Donut+Rockstar. Three replies pick Seeker+Donut, one adds that below 5★ Seeker the Grapevine+Skating version is better.

sources.title: 아레나 들개자리에 감감쓰면됨?
sources.titleEn: Moon Rabbit in Hound's slot?
sources.summaryEn: Hound gives Range synergy, which aligns Macaron's march; Milky Way ruins Macaron's alignment and must go. Standard tank trio: Hound, Ion, Moon Rabbit.

sources.title: 브시커 스킬가속 필수임?
sources.titleEn: Is skill haste mandatory on Bright Seeker?
sources.summaryEn: Author's Bright Seeker sugar rune has 4 unlocked lines (SR 스가 +3.00, SR 공증 4.70%, SSR 공증 6.50%, SSR 공증 6.10%) and thinks the ATK% lines must go for raid (to keep Seeker's ATK under Milk). Commenters: reroll everything and aim for at least two SSR 스가 lines; one notes that with only 4 slots even full SSR 스가 barely passes 40, so maybe 1 스가 + 3 스증.

sources.title: 아레나 명중안챙겨도 할만하네
sources.titleEn: Arena is fine without accuracy
sources.summaryEn: Poster removed the one accuracy line and barely sees MISS; enemy evasion is around 650.

sources.title: 와 토벌 프리셋 신세계네 진짜
sources.titleEn: Wow, a raid gear preset is a whole new world
sources.summaryEn: Author built a gear preset picking only 스증/스가/피감 and says raid score jumped. A long comment thread lays out a four-preset system: raid (스증치피, 스증스가, 피감체력, 스가피감), arena (스증치확, 스증스가, 피감치저, 스가피감), stage 55% 'raw power' preset and stage 35% 'solid power' preset with 명중/집중. Explains why crit dmg beats crit rate in raid: monsters have no crit resistance and buffs push crit rate very high.

sources.title: [일반] 소과금은 현질할 이유가 사라진듯

The poster's own attack team at 2,118 pts is the standard 12 at Lv.100. A commenter says names are hidden from Elite Master to stop sniping.

sources.title: 이면 6단계 15% 비틀기 성공
sources.titleEn: Rift level 6 twisted through at 15%
sources.summaryEn: Text only: Rift level 6 (the Cake Hound Pack, per rift-bosses.json) cleared at 15%, with the lineup Macaron, Brightseeker, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Witchberry, Bari, Tiger Lily (정전), Rockstar, Milk, Cherry Cola, Dark Choco. A commenter asks for the pets; no answer.

sources.title: 이면 15퍼 쿨민
sources.titleEn: Rift Cool Mint at 15%
sources.summaryEn: In-Rift screenshot of Noah (Lv.190, Rift rank 86th): '차원의 이면 12단계', Cool Mint at 0.000%, header 20G 453M 993K, gear preset '스가x'. The poster says this deck clears everything at 15% except the Cake Hound Pack; Werehound Princess and GingerCraven might fall with a lot of time but aren't worth it. In the comments the poster clears the three trucks by dropping Herb or Cherry Cola for Dark Choco and stacking Devil's and Dark Choco's DEF shred, pushing them to 9 or 7 o'clock; Devil survives thanks to the Rift buff.

sources.title: 이면 와서 어이없었던거
sources.titleEn: What baffled me on reaching the Rift
sources.summaryEn: The level-10 clear frame is time-limited; GingerCraven is practically impossible at 15%, so you idle until 35%; the all-server #1 stood at level 20 for over 30 hours.

sources.title: 와레나 익명은 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: What is 'anonymous' in Rumble?
sources.summaryEn: Image 1 is a defense-log entry: an anonymous 2000+ attacker running the standard 12 with Hot Doggie, King Choco Drop and Holy Baby Drop beat the poster's defense (방어 실패 −1). Image 2 is the revenge screen: the same kind of defense with 2 of 12 slots hidden and a win reward of 35-39 points, against the poster 센구 (S0387, 11.3M, 1,931 pts) whose attack team is the standard 12 at Lv.100. A commenter says this shows above 2,000 points.

sources.title: 위치베리 좋은거 알겠는데 시발롬들아
sources.titleEn: Everyone says Witchberry is great, tell me the deck
sources.summaryEn: The Witchberry stage deck written out twice in comments, with pets: Battery mellow and Hotdog fixed, pouch and Holy Baby Drop swapped per boss.

sources.title: 호밀덱<<락스타가 맞는거같은데??
sources.titleEn: Rockstar is right for the Rye deck
sources.summaryEn: With Rockstar in, the poster's Rye deck survives the Bari-Oven opening burst. Comments: one dropped Skating, Donut, Seeker and Herb and beat a 10★ Bari for the first time, but after ~50 fights says it can't beat a properly set Bari deck; a commenter points to the Rumble #8 deck (Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Grapevine, Milk, Hound, Rockstar, Ion, Moon Rabbit + Lime). The image is a sticker.

sources.title: 님들 아레나 명중은 꼭 맞추샘
sources.titleEn: Always set accuracy for Arena
sources.summaryEn: Evasion-deck user (17th, 12.47M) beats a 14.08M 45th player; remembers low-accuracy players and farms them. Vampire's panel: accuracy 1,093, evasion 1,223.7, evasion rate 24.40%, focus 1,268.84, resist 658.1. Gear preset '아레나 회피' with +15 pieces. Raw evasion 1,200 plus Mango Toucan 10% is about 1,300; magic-object types sit at 80 base evasion, others 100+.

sources.title: 와레나 상위권 갈수록 회피덱 많네
sources.titleEn: More evasion decks higher up in Rumble
sources.summaryEn: Evasion decks get more common higher up the Rumble ladder, so the poster is going to add two accuracy lines.

sources.title: 8단계 비틀기성공
sources.titleEn: Level 8 twisted through
sources.summaryEn: A 15% 'twist' (비틀기) clear of Rift level 8. The screenshot is the in-Rift battle screen of 카린 (Lv.188, Rift rank 188th): header team power 12G 152M 606K, boss 초코크림 늑대 망치공주 at 0.000%, '차원의 이면 8단계', fight clock 1.100. 카린 is the player who cleared 328-30 at 4.00G (dc:76835, first round), so the Rift header shows about three times their lobby power.

sources.title: 회피덱 맛있네
sources.titleEn: Evasion deck is tasty
sources.summaryEn: Battle at 16.47M (7th) vs 17.11M (6th): the poster's Rye shows evasion 1,386.25, accuracy 660.12, focus 993.26, resist 680.7. Levels are tuned so Rye gets Pomegranate's beam since it is not all ATK runes. Pets Cheese drop, Hot Doggie, Rapid Fire pet; perks Armor Repair + Passion Pay. A commenter: an accuracy-built opponent shreds it.

sources.title: 방금 와레나 투력 10m차이 이김;
sources.titleEn: Just won Rumble at a 10M power gap
sources.summaryEn: 우이's 12.48M deck beat a 22.72M deck (Bari, Brightseeker, Oven, Rye and the standard supports). Crepe and then Rye died first, but Vampire and Pinot chipped the rest down; the poster credits Milk (2,893,597 healing) and Lime (1,408,960). The win gave +8 points (2,390, 983rd) and 175 medals. Commenters say both sides were under-built (Stella not unlocked, Bari 4★).

sources.title: 나보다 투력낮은 바리뽑은 새끼들한테 지는 섭1위들 필독.txt
sources.titleEn: For server #1s losing to lower-power Bari players
sources.summaryEn: Server #1's fix without pulling Bari: Rye deck with Espresso swapped for Rockstar, Milk captain, 3 tanks + Armor Repair, pets King Choco Drop + 'the new pet' + Holy Baby Drop; Brightseeker does the cutting. Unsure what happens if Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola adds Adventurer.

sources.title: [일반] 지금 스텔라 한계치가 8텔라 9별인가
sources.titleEn: Is the Stellar cap constellation 8, point 9? (15 stars a point)
sources.summaryEn: Each Stellar point takes 15 cookie stars. With all cookies maxed there are only 73 stars left to gain (excluding Ceylon Knight), so constellation 8 stops at 9 points. A commenter puts the current maximum at 754 total stars, counting Ceylon at 4-star.

Screenshot: 289-30 Cool Mint at 0.000% with the CRISPY CLEAR banner at team power 1G 288M 248K (33.5% of 3.840G: the 15% bracket). Poster hasn't found 15% decks for every boss: GingerCraven (best 14% left) and Redberry Assassins still leave ticks; at those he swaps a power-padded gear set to reach 35%. Perks '20 7', pets 와사비, 난타, 색동.

sources.title: 와레나에 회슝좍 방덱 갑자기 늘었네
sources.titleEn: Evasion defenses suddenly common in Rumble
sources.summaryEn: Evasion defenses suddenly increased, but their pets give them away, so the attacker switches to the stage gear preset and beats them. Replies: one runs no pet because 1,300 evasion is enough; another explains that without Fluffy Cheese Cat Vampire bites fewer times and without the evasion pet the dodging is less reliable, so evasion decks get swept by 3-charger Bari decks unless they are much stronger.

sources.title: 명중 스캠된 이유가 시커 스킬이 이상하게 나가는데?
sources.titleEn: Why accuracy became a scam: Seeker skill behaves oddly
sources.summaryEn: 언담's test at accuracy 600 (301-3, Pomegranate Beetle): each Brightseeker drone volley rolls hit/miss on its first shot and keeps it (all hit or all miss). Scorpion rolls accuracy on every poison tick and a missed stinger adds no stack, so low accuracy cuts Scorpion twice. Witchberry, Choux Cream, Bari, Cherry Cola, Rye showed no such effect.

sources.title: 회피 1400인데 명중600한테 개쳐맞는데?
sources.titleEn: 1,400 evasion but hit by 600 accuracy
sources.summaryEn: Test with 1,400 evasion still gets hit by 600-accuracy attackers. Replies: one accuracy line breaks an evasion set; it only works against zero accuracy lines; a commenter thought each 100 evasion gave just under 10% miss.

sources.title: 위치베리 오토덱 개좋은데왜
sources.titleEn: Witchberry auto deck is great, why
sources.summaryEn: Full-auto push with ~70% Witchberry deck (3.74G formation) and ~30% Bari deck (3.86G); screenshot 324-18 Ginkgoblin Bombers at 3G 746M 582K (35%: 41.7%), blessing Lv.9. Bari deck used for the whole snowfield (pouch pet fixed) and the desert bombers; beach split; Witchberry elsewhere. Rune details for Witchberry and Rockstar given. 킬러: at 15% only Scorpion–Cola twisting works.

sources.title: 오토 위치베리덱 35퍼 추가 공략
sources.titleEn: Witchberry auto deck at 35%, extra guide
sources.summaryEn: 언담's guide (links dc:76804): with infinite retry by macro the Witchberry deck auto-clears city through village Cool Mint without changes; GingerCraven falls under 30% then clears; Spactus, bombers, plaza assassins all auto. At village Cool Mint swap Hotdog for 복주머니; 복주머니 also needed for snowfield giants and grassland King Choco Drop worms. Black-hood enemies need a little hugging control. ~30 stages/day. Formation 1.54G at time (now 2G+). 러너 pushes to 327 with it; 아노크로와상 at 307 with 2.7G (conquest gear, pouch for 갓방울).

sources.title: [일반] 너네 주간열쇠랑 2만원 열쇠패키지 삼?
sources.titleEn: Weekly keys and the 20,000 KRW key pack: buy?
sources.summaryEn: Weekly keys yes; the 20,000 KRW key package (3 weeks left) wait for the patch. Some skip keys as Daily Dungeons stall and the rune keys aren't worth it.

sources.title: 이면 4단계 3트럭 뭐임 ㅅㅂ????
sources.titleEn: What is Rift level 4, the three trucks?
sources.summaryEn: A player stuck at level 4 asks whether the three trucks can be beaten at 15%. Two commenters say they cleared it at 15%; one adds that if it won't go, clear it at the next 차원의 힘 level, and that the trucks come back several times.

sources.title: 와레나 쌀숭이덱 그마찍먹함
sources.titleEn: Touched Grand Master with my Rye deck
sources.summaryEn: 길룡부하 reached Rumble Grand Master 3 for the first time this season (4,000 gems) at 101st with a 22.54M Rye deck, beating a 28.14M opponent at 116th. The lineup on the battle screen is Macaron, Doughnut King, Cheesecake, Grapevine, Milk, Ion over Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Rockstar, Hound, Moon Rabbit, all Lv.100. Asked his oven level, he answers 37.

sources.title: 근데 와레나 랭커들 바리덱 이거 호밀덱으로 잘잡는거 맞나;;
sources.titleEn: Do Rye decks really beat Rumble rankers' Bari decks?
sources.summaryEn: Rumble: a 4.5M Rye deck lost 5 in a row to a 5.01M Bari deck (4.94M, 3,472 in the log). Comments: Rye that beats Bari is usually 8★+; Rye must be top-3 ATK for the first beam (tune Pinot's level down); get merc level 4 for the DR 10% perk; one commenter with plate and gear all +15 holds regular-Arena GM top 10 at 축4.

sources.title: 이면은 그나마 들개 쿨민은 15%컷 가능하네
sources.titleEn: In the Rift, at least the Cake Hounds and Cool Mint go at 15%
sources.summaryEn: Text: Bari plus pierce (관통) cookies herd and kill the mob-heavy levels well; 'if you can't make 35%, try 15% with a skill-AMP/skill-haste preset'. In the comments the author says single-target bosses are practically impossible at 15% (once saw a boss down to 15% HP, gave up over the retries); GingerCraven is easy at 35% with Brightseeker, Scorpion and Cherry Cola alone; the Cake Hounds and Cool Mint fell at 15% to a Bari–Oven Wanderer–Skating Queen plus Witchberry–바궁–Rockstar combination; the Werehound Princess and the three trucks are hard at 15%.

sources.title: [📚정보] 일던 650이상 투력1.8g 공략
sources.titleEn: Daily dungeons 650+ at 1.8G
sources.summaryEn: Perks for EXP only Health Insurance + Armor Repair; EXP auto, else drone hit-and-run, else sweep; corner play for coin and dough.

sources.title: 호밀포도락스타 아레나 좋더라
sources.titleEn: Rye + Grapevine + Rockstar is good in Arena
sources.summaryEn: The poster attacks with Rye + Grapevine + Rockstar and holds defense with a Bari deck against a rival for village chief. Commenters ask for the deck and say their Rye decks get cut by Bari decks.

sources.title: 이면 투력 60G 돌파 ㅇㅅㅇ
sources.titleEn: Rift power past 60G
sources.summaryEn: 다함께차차차 (Lv.191, Rift rank 11th, 축복 Lv.10, 돌파력 1114): in-Rift header 63G 232M 704K at 차원의 힘 Lv.19 (366/14,820), '차원의 이면 25단계 반복 중'. Asked for their stage team power, the poster answers 'about 6.4'. Level 25 is a GingerCraven level (the level cycle); its 35% line is 65.29G, so at 63.23G the player sits 2G under it.

sources.title: 이면 잘아는사람있어? 35%넘겼는대 딜이안드감
sources.titleEn: Anyone know the Rift? I'm past 35% but damage doesn't land
sources.summaryEn: 'Level-10 GingerCraven's 35% is about 16G; why does nothing land at 17G?' Reply: the 35% cut is 40% of recommended power. Level 10's 35% line is 18.76G (rift-levels.json), so at 17G the poster was in the 15% bracket and GingerCraven took no damage.

sources.title: (정보) 차원의 이면 정보, 전투력 컷
sources.titleEn: (Info) Dimensional Rift info and power cuts
sources.summaryEn: An info post: you need about 4G (328-30's 35% cut) to reach the Rift; inside, 차원의 힘 accrues at n per minute where n is the Rift level, and levelling it raises power; the structure is to raise power while idle, match each boss's 35% cut, and push. 'Some bosses fall at the 15% cut too: I took level 3, the Werehound Princess, at 15%.' Screenshots: 차원의 힘 Lv.4 (1,850/2,040) at 'level 4 repeating'; the Lv.4 effects (Rift ATK, DEF and HP amplification +30%, crit damage +90%, crit rate +30%, focus +15%, accuracy +20%); a table of the cuts per level (100%, 15% at 20%, 35% at 40%, 55% at 60%) for levels 1-25, which matches curated/rift-levels.json. Comments: the Rift's power is its own, from 차원의 힘; for 15% 'shred well' and stack Dark Choco to 10 with skill 2.

sources.title: 와레나 200위 호밀덱 푼다
sources.titleEn: My 200th-place Rumble Rye deck
sources.summaryEn: 도토리마스터 shares his 20.39M Rye deck at about 200th; Rye is still 8★ and he expects more at 9★. Against Bari decks Skating Queen wins more often than Grapevine, but in Rye mirrors Grapevine is better (poster). A commenter says this list tops out around 200th and is adding Brightseeker.

sources.title: 이건 아무리고민해도 방덱오픈이 맞다
sources.titleEn: Opening the defense deck is the right call
sources.summaryEn: Arena ranking (1st 3,460, 2nd 3,364, 3rd 3,362); the 4th and 5th defenses show grey hidden placeholders among their cards, and the poster (6th, 3,260) shows a single Lv.1 cookie as an 'open' defense so lower players can farm him. He can't beat the top 5 because of their spec. A commenter keeps an open defense to burn tickets on revenges and still gets top-75 rewards.

sources.title: 호밀덱으로 바리덱 카운터 치긴하는데 이게 맞나?
sources.titleEn: Countering Bari with Rye, but is this right?
sources.summaryEn: Two damage tables where the Rye dies almost at once but Pinot Noir carries: Pinot 1,567,946 and 1,582,031, Hound 1,118,505 and 673,232, Rye only 55,303 and 127,982. Opponents: Bari 1,383,770 / Oven 729,086 / Cherry Cola 513,905 with Crepe in the top 8, and Bari 1,926,485 / Oven 855,716 / Cherry Cola 386,611 with Hound. No server tags and the poster's '우리서버엔 10성이 업수우' point to regular Arena (L). Commenters: skill-haste Pinot with Chain is very strong (Chain 4 hits at 80-90% with crit-down, roughly every 1.5 s).

sources.title: 이면 11 12 비틀기 덱
sources.titleEn: Rift levels 11 and 12: the twist decks
sources.summaryEn: 카린 again (Lv.189): two in-Rift battle screenshots with the decks used to 'twist' levels 11 and 12. Level 11, 케이크 들개떼: header 17G 796M 59K, boss at 4%, clock 7.733. Level 12, 쿨링민트맛 쿠키: header 18G 398M 14K, boss 0.000%, clock 1.567. Both are the 15% bracket. Comments ask about level 8 (Werehound Princess) and level-10 GingerCraven at 17.2G, which deals no damage.

sources.title: 열정페이 해골물임?
sources.titleEn: Is Passion Pay a placebo?
sources.summaryEn: Test: Passion Pay landed on Milk only once her ATK shown in the cookie window, without the captain's +10%, was the highest; counting the captain bonus she was already first but did not get it. Two replies agree the captain effect is separate.

sources.title: 아레나 공격자 보정 100% 있는듯
sources.titleEn: There must be an attacker bonus in Arena
sources.summaryEn: Same power, same decks: 10/10 attacks win, 10/10 defenses lose against the same player. Says the same holds in Rumble. Two commenters agree.

sources.title: [일반] 길드 있고 없고 차이 엄청 크네
sources.titleEn: Big difference with a guild: +2G account total
sources.summaryEn: Same poster as dc:81826, a week earlier: joining a guild raised total power by 2G.

sources.title: 아 3트럭 좃같네
sources.titleEn: The three trucks are awful
sources.summaryEn: In-Rift screenshot of '차원의 이면 14단계': 폭주단 트럭 at 6% with the clock at 0.000, so the fight timed out. The poster confirms it was at 15% and still hasn't cleared it.

sources.title: 크럼블 던전 하루에 3번 박아야함?
sources.titleEn: Must I run it three times a day?
sources.summaryEn: One run a day is enough; enter and leave at zero to clear missions. Gnome Lab has a +1 daily-entry node.

sources.title: [일반] 연구석 1m~1.5m 들어가는 체력,공격력,크확 있으면 그것부터 올려라
sources.titleEn: Do the 1–1.5M-stone HP/ATK/crit nodes first
sources.summaryEn: Lab order advice: take the cheap (1–1.5M research stone) HP, ATK and crit nodes first; of the special 30% nodes take only HP 30% now, and the ATK 30% one after clearing some of the lower nodes, because those raise power more.

sources.title: [📚정보] 경던오토덱 이거 좋음
sources.titleEn: This EXP auto deck is good
sources.summaryEn: Solo-Brightseeker deck with Skating Queen at 696: no control at all; ATK-20 and 3-tank perks.

sources.title: 바리 걍 스킵 때려야지
sources.titleEn: Just skipping Bari
sources.summaryEn: The poster will skip Bari: it is a Rumble one-trick that only works because Rumble's buff favours it, and the season rewards don't motivate him. Commenters: Bari will be used whenever an overpowered charger comes out since it buffs chargers; others say chargers are weak by design and new strong cookies will crowd Bari out.

sources.title: 풍뎅이 연타덱이 더편하노
sources.titleEn: Multi-hit deck prayer beats grinding Scorpion
sources.summaryEn: Screenshot: 237-1 Pomegranate Beetles at 0.000% with 474M 248K (35%: 45.3%), gear preset '명중/집중', multi-hit (연타) deck. Comment: the Cherry Cola multi-hit deck kills beetles better than the Bari deck.

sources.title: 8성 호밀로 10성 오방바리덱 컷
sources.titleEn: 8★ Rye cuts a 10★ Oven-Bari deck
sources.summaryEn: Damage table (mode not shown): an 8★-Rye deck beat a 10★ Oven-Bari deck. Winner: Rye 2,075,605, Hound 1,007,613, Brightseeker 893,198, Macaron 398,708, Ion 115,517, Moon Rabbit 91,280, Pinot 34,070, Rockstar 1,546. sources.title: [📚정보] 내부 로직 (피해산출, 전투력 등)
sources.titleEn: Internal logic: the damage and combat power formulas (decompiled)
sources.summaryEn: Decompiled formulas (by the leaker 삥삥, marked work in progress) for damage and for the displayed combat power (CP). Per cookie: offense = ATK × (crit dmg × crit rate + 1) × √(accuracy/AA + 1) × √(focus/AA + 1) × (focus% + 1) × (accuracy% + 1) × (element bonus × 0.5 + 1) × (boss dmg × 0.5 + 1); DEF factor = ln(DEF/5,000,000 + 1) + 1; survival = (crit resist + 1) × (HP × DEF factor) × √(evasion/AA + 1) × √(resist/AA + 1) × (resist% + 1) × (evasion% + 1); combined = √( 1/(1 − dmg reduction) × survival × 1/(1 − element reduction × 0.5) × offense ); utility = (speed/speed const + ability haste/1,000,000 + skill amp) × utility coefficient; CP(1 cookie) = floor((utility + 1) × combined × role coefficient); team CP = sum of members' floored CP. Constants: AA (accuracy/avoidance) = 5,000,000, Defense = 5,000,000, AbilityHaste = 1,000,000; role coefficient defense 1.0, charge 1.027, shooter 1.095 (support/heal/speed/utility coefficient included). Guild Conquest recommended power = 10,004,798,560 (about 10G). Team CP ÷ recommended indexes a CP penalty band in the damage formula. Damage = ATK × skill multiplier × 1/(1 + DEF/500) × crit × (1 + skill amp) × element × (1 + boss dmg, vs bosses only) × (1 + final dmg) × (1 − dmg reduction) × CP penalty.

sources.title: 토벌전 피냐타 분석 - 최종 수정 완 (10/7 01:27)
sources.titleEn: Conquest Piñata analysis, final revision
sources.summaryEn: Datamined boss analysis by 삥삥. 60 s fight against an unkillable body (HP 4.6E); score = damage dealt to the body only (summon damage not counted). Body DEF 2000 → taken damage ×0.2; Dark, Light attackers ×1.15; crit resistance 0; immune to lift/knockback/control. Each 12 s spawner adds a self-buff about 10.5 s later that raises DMG reduction (0→10→30→50→70→90%) and multiplies body ATK (5K → 750M). Summons scale exponentially and cause the late wipe. Advice: front-load damage in 0–34 s.

sources.summaryEn: Side-by-side of the leak and the 10-08 patch notes. Leak: cookie max level 100 → 150, EXP for Lv.100–150 = 8.33G, Crumble level max 350; Gnome Lab basic 111–130 (+33 nodes) needing 18.89G basic research stones and 150 special stones, ATK amp +370% among effects, 68.9 days of research time; daily dungeons 770 → 900. A commenter reads it as Skating Queen -> Adventurer; the poster says Skating wanders into the enemy side and gets cut. The second screenshot is a Rumble Elite Master 1 promotion (19.13M vs 20.55M). Another commenter beat a deck like this on his server with the usual Rye deck.

sources.title: 이면이랑 마일리지랑 숫자 바뀐거아님??
sources.titleEn: Didn't they swap the Rift and mileage numbers?
sources.summaryEn: 헬게이트 complains the 10-08 Rift exchange gets fewer purchases than the mileage shop; his 'played the game' proof shows 차원의 힘 Lv.24 (4,017/20,160) while repeating Rift level 33.

sources.title: 이면 과금러의 희망은 그래도 이거아님?
sources.titleEn: The Rift spenders' hope
sources.summaryEn: Quotes the notes: Rift season 2 level-clear rewards add syrup molten (시럽쇳물), an SSR select box and 1-minute accelerators. Comments: only tens; from level 40-ish; two at every x9 level.

sources.title: 280-30 비겁 35퍼 팁좀
sources.titleEn: 280-30 GingerCraven at 35%, tips
sources.summaryEn: Stacks Scorpion to 20 at 65-75% HP before fear, best ~20% HP left. Perks 초고속승진 + 열정페이. Fixed: Milk, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Scorpion, Moon Rabbit, Seeker, Cheesecake, Cherry Cola; rotating Dark Choco, Herb, Pinot, Bari, Tiger Lily, Macaron, Lime; arena 6-haste preset at 35%. Advice: lower tanks' levels so Lime/Macaron's beam goes to dealers; arena set lacks accuracy, add an accuracy pet (Angry Bird for Hotdog); key is keeping Cheesecake-boosted Milk's 10 ATK stacks on Seeker, Cola, Scorpion: move little and keep together.

sources.title: [유출] 탈퇴기념 방랑자길드 토벌 유출
sources.titleEn: [Leak] Leaving the 방랑자 guild, leaking their conquest info
sources.summaryEn: Claims to leak Arsen's stat weights: skill amp +1% → +2% damage; crit rate +15% → +3%; crit damage +15% → +4%; ATK +650 → +2.5%, varying with breakthrough, research, gear, Stella. Commenters say it's old news; the 'real' tip is minimum skill haste then crit damage.

sources.title: [일반] 경던 벽느껴지는데 뭐 바꿔야할꺼있노?
sources.titleEn: Hitting a wall in EXP
sources.summaryEn: Stuck at 746 at 4.61G with the copied auto deck; retry or drop Dark Choco.

sources.title: 샤르도네 다발 주고 탄속 받으면
sources.titleEn: If Chardonnay gives Volley and receives Projectile Speed
sources.summaryEn: Speculation ahead of release: Chardonnay gives Volley and receives Projectile Speed, as Milk does, and a Projectile Speed recipient throws its buff further. No dungeon run yet.

sources.title: [일반] 올소탕 기준이면 6천원 열쇠패키지 안사냐?
sources.titleEn: Sweeping everything: skip the 6,000 KRW key pack?
sources.summaryEn: Whether to buy the 6,000 KRW key package when only sweeping: most still buy it, for the research stones it gives (3,000 KRW with a Galaxy Store discount).

sources.title: 뒷라인 빼면 크던 우유 바로나오네
sources.titleEn: Take out the back line and Milk comes out at once
sources.summaryEn: Removing back-line cookies brings Milk out at once. Replies: lowering Pomegranate to Lv.60 made Milk run forward immediately, confirmed by a second player; deleveled supports follow her; the placement is by power order.

sources.title: [일반] 열쇠패키지 사지마?
sources.titleEn: Don't buy the key packs?
sources.summaryEn: With no dungeon expansion in the 10-08 update, commenters say buy only the 6,000 KRW key package and skip larger key packages.

sources.title: 크던 428G
sources.titleEn: Crumble Dungeon 428G
sources.summaryEn: Result screen: 428.96G at 14.45G total power, current rank 3rd (up one), 0.000 s left. Run on a flat-ATK Conquest gear preset; the poster calls Milk and Cheesecake staying together the key. The board strip behind shows 704.63G in 1st on that server and Seed at 406.15G.

sources.title: 난 비겁 쿨민 넣어야 깨지더라
sources.titleEn: I only clear GingerCraven with Cool Mint in
sources.summaryEn: 리폿 (Lv.188, stage rank 12th) cleared 323-30 GingerCraven at 3G 623M 49K (0.000%, clock 3.600) with Cool Mint in the deck, gear preset '비겁'.

sources.title: 밑에 크던 우유 빨리 나오는 거 알려준 쿠박이 ㄳㄳ
sources.titleEn: Thanks for the tip that gets Milk out early
sources.summaryEn: After resetting power: dropped the buffers that cast at once, filled the power cutoff with dealers that stand and auto-attack like Dark Choco, and lowered Pomegranate's level; Milk now runs straight in. Previous limit 180G. The screenshot is mid-fight (3.24G at 50.9 s, 11.33G total power), not a result.

sources.title: Crumb 슈가룬 최적화 툴 48시간 한정 공개 (+ 비법소스에 대해)
sources.titleEn: Crumb sugar-rune optimizer open for 48 hours (+ on the secret sauce)
sources.summaryEn: Arsen (Season 6 #1, crumb.gg developer) says the 'secret sauce' is many small optimizations stacked up, plus money. He publishes crumb.gg tools: sugar-rune optimizer (48 h), plate-enhancement simulator, formula/damage visualizer. Screenshots: optimizer suggests Milk all ATK%, Tea Knight/Cheesecake/Pomegranate all skill amp; damage calculator for Brightseeker; cheapest +15→+20 plate path.

sources.title: [일반] 경던 이거 못깨는데
sources.titleEn: Can't clear this EXP stage
sources.summaryEn: Unused keys vanish at midnight; a commenter cleared in two tries after swapping stage gear for Conquest gear; others point to the 746 auto deck.

sources.title: 그래서 샤르도네 슈가룬
sources.titleEn: So, Chardonnay's sugar runes
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether Chardonnay wants 스증+스가. Replies: all skill amp; her skill has a 4 s cooldown and 5 s duration and she already has 75% skill ready (스킬준비), so there's no reason for skill haste.

sources.title: 오늘업뎃 - 상세수치
sources.titleEn: Today's update: detailed numbers (leak)
sources.summaryEn: Datamined summary of the 10-08 update. Cookie max level Lv.100 → Lv.120: 251.89M cookie EXP per cookie for 100→120, requires crumble (account) level 200, the last level costs 31.23M. Main stage 328-30 → 364-30; research +33 tiers (111→130); Chardonnay packages; monster balance nerfs to daily dungeons; client logic version 9 → 11. Nothing on Guild Conquest balance.

sources.title: 120렙도 못찍는거아님?
sources.titleEn: Can't we even reach Lv.120?
sources.summaryEn: Cookie Lv.120 needs Crumble (account) level 200; commenters at about 190 expect Lv.117–118 for now.

sources.title: 치확 버프는 중첩 안 됨? 마카롱+샤르도네 둘 다 쓰기 불가능?
sources.titleEn: Don't crit buffs stack? Can't run Macaron and Chardonnay together?
sources.summaryEn: Question whether Macaron's and Chardonnay's crit buffs stack. Answer: no, so Chardonnay is a straight replacement.

sources.title: 이제 토벌전 무한리트 조금은 나아지겠네
sources.titleEn: Conquest's endless retries should ease a bit now
sources.summaryEn: With Chardonnay replacing Macaron, the move-speed lines put in for Macaron's positioning can all come out, so conquest needs fewer retries. Commenter: but the ceiling is said to be Macaron.

sources.title: 샤르도네 근데 석류 빨대 하나 무조건가져가는구나..;;;
sources.titleEn: Chardonnay always takes one Pomegranate straw..
sources.summaryEn: Because Chardonnay receives the 탄속 (Projectile Speed) synergy, she always takes one of Pomegranate's buff links. Commenters say that's good: players already levelled fillers down and gave Macaron ATK runes to steer a straw to the crit buffer, and since the 다발 synergy they had already tuned Pomegranate's straw to go to Macaron, so little changes.

sources.title: 토벌 마카롱 일렬서도 샤르도네가 좋은거임?
sources.titleEn: Is Chardonnay better even when Macaron lines up in conquest?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether both give 120% crit. Reply: Chardonnay is 탄속 so she always gets Pomegranate's buff; just replace Macaron.

sources.title: 석류 무조건받는데 걍 올스가가 낫지않냐
sources.titleEn: She always gets Pomegranate, so isn't all skill haste better?
sources.summaryEn: Suggests all-skill-haste Chardonnay since her damage is decent. Rebuttal: duration 5 s, cooldown 4 s, so haste is pointless.

sources.title: 샤르 스증 주는 이유가 뭐임?
sources.titleEn: Why give Chardonnay skill amp?
sources.summaryEn: The skill text lists only Push RES as not scaling with skill amp, so her crit buff scales; Macaron also ran skill amp.

sources.title: 궁금한게 샤르랑 정전쓰면
sources.titleEn: Question: running Chardonnay and Tiger Lily together
sources.summaryEn: With Chardonnay and Tiger Lily, only Tiger Lily's 다발 3 buff applies, so Pomegranate fires 5 lines, not 6: the best volley buff overwrites rather than adds. Commenters: Pomegranate rarely got Tiger Lily's buff anyway, because she casts immediately and stays put while the line advances, while Tiger Lily must reach the enemy and mount her tiger (base 10 s transform cooldown) to give the synergy. Author: with 0 skill haste on Chardonnay her volley buff sometimes drops.

sources.title: 샤르도네 딜이상한건 석류빨대확정이라 그럼..
sources.titleEn: Chardonnay's weird damage is because she's a guaranteed Pomegranate straw
sources.summaryEn: Chardonnay's high damage is explained by her guaranteed Pomegranate straw (탄속 synergy); commenter adds her own 250% ATK skill coefficient.

sources.title: 치확 증가는 스증 버프 받는거 아님?
sources.titleEn: Doesn't the crit-rate increase scale with skill amp?
sources.summaryEn: Settles the 83083 rumour: only Chardonnay's Push RES ignores skill amp; her crit-rate buff does scale with skill amp, so all skill amp is standard.

sources.title: 이제 토벌 체리빼고 뭐씀 ?
sources.titleEn: What goes in conquest now instead of Cherry?
sources.summaryEn: Asks for Cherry's replacement in conquest. Reply: test 호밀 (Rye) or 메소 (Melon Soda) in that position, since the world-line (formation alignment) no longer matters. Image is a fan GIF.

sources.title: 토벌 그럼 이제 석류가 정전 버프 못받는거마즘?
sources.titleEn: So in conquest Pomegranate can't get Tiger Lily's buff now?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether Pomegranate no longer receives Tiger Lily's buff, since she isn't pushed back (Chardonnay's Push RES) and stays put attacking. No replies.

sources.title: 토벌 렙따는 그대로임 ?
sources.titleEn: Is conquest level-steering (렙따) unchanged?
sources.summaryEn: Asks if level manipulation stays. Replies: ATK order should stay; keep levelling down so Cheesecake, Skating Queen and Tea Knight get straws; Chardonnay gets a straw anyway, so she can be max level.

sources.title: 토벌전 샤르도네 8성 vs 마카롱 9성
sources.titleEn: Conquest: Chardonnay 8★ vs Macaron 9★
sources.summaryEn: Head-to-head by one player. Chardonnay 8★ (all-skill-amp runes only half done), Brightseeker crit 710%, Cherry swapped for Melon Soda: 3.6T. Macaron 9★ (all-skill-amp SSR runes), Brightseeker crit 740%, Cherry kept: 3.8T. Commenters: Chardonnay beats Macaron from 9★; at 8★ she gives 108% crit, so for conquest she must be 9★.

sources.title: 토벌 그래서 이제 어떻게해야되냐?
sources.titleEn: So what do I do in conquest now?
sources.summaryEn: F2P asks for the ATK order and whether to swap Cherry for Melon Soda (yes). Reply: same as before, but Milk and Chardonnay take fixed straws, so steer the rest to Cheesecake, Skating Queen and Tea Knight; Brightseeker also gets one, almost fixed by TSSR power. Pre-patch, with Pomegranate on Tiger Lily's volley synergy, the straws went Brightseeker, Milk, Macaron, Cheesecake, Skating Queen, Tea Knight; now Chardonnay takes Macaron's place.

sources.title: 그니까 샤르도네 슈가룬이
sources.titleEn: So, Chardonnay's sugar runes
sources.summaryEn: Author proposes ATK / skill amp / haste, take the best roll, ATK maybe since she does 250% ATK. Commenters: all skill amp to raise the team crit; crit dmg is the only alternative worth thinking about (arena where Skating Queen is absent); never haste or ATK, since Milk's ATK buff makes ATK runes near worthless for everyone but Milk. One adds she's already fast and teams have 6 haste from gear; another says Pomegranate sometimes drops off.

sources.title: 토벌 고점은 마카롱아님??
sources.titleEn: Isn't Macaron still the conquest ceiling?
sources.summaryEn: The poster argues that dropping from 다발 3 to 다발 2 costs a beam among Milk, Seeker, Cheesecake, Tea Knight and Skating Queen, so Macaron may still be the ceiling. Commenters answer that Tiger Lily stays in the deck, so Chardonnay replaces only Macaron; one notes 70%+ of conquest damage comes from Brightseeker and that the ceiling needs Tiger Lily's 다발 to reach Pomegranate.

sources.title: ㅅㅂ 팀투 3G인데 토벌 1T 400G 나오네ㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: Team power 3G and conquest gives 1T 400G lol
sources.summaryEn: 볼고그라드 (who built Chardonnay all-skill-amp in 83255) scores 1T 400G at team power 3G in Season 7 with Chardonnay. No lineup shown.

sources.title: 석류가 정전 받긴 하냐
sources.titleEn: Does Pomegranate even get Tiger Lily's buff?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether Pomegranate still gets Tiger Lily's buff. Mixed replies: one says she does; others say with Chardonnay she isn't pushed back, so the buff doesn't reach her. Image is a cat emoticon.

sources.title: 석류 빨대 정전 치케 쓰면 3+3+1+1 해서 8명 까지 꽂혀??
sources.titleEn: With Tiger Lily and Cheesecake, do Pomegranate's straws reach 8 (3+3+1+1)?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether volley buffs stack to 8 Pomegranate targets. Replies: only the highest applies; one answers '3+3'. Image is unrelated (a League of Legends splash).

sources.title: 이러면 토벌전 체리덱에서 뚱카롱만 빼면 되나?
sources.titleEn: So just pull Macaron from the conquest Cherry deck?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether to just swap Macaron, keep Tiger Lily and keep levels. Replies: swap Cherry for Melon Soda too; Cherry was only there for formation around Macaron, so move speed can go. Another: Cherry's slot is certainly a damage dealer now, which one is to be researched; Tiger Lily is hard to replace because Cheesecake getting one more skill-amp buff beats one extra dealer.

sources.title: 샤르도네 스증 공증 두개 붙이는게 맞것지?
sources.titleEn: Chardonnay: skill amp plus ATK% runes, right?
sources.summaryEn: The author planned ATK% runes on Chardonnay so she would get Pomegranate's buff. Commenters correct him: as a Projectile Speed (탄속) synergy recipient she is Pomegranate's first straw target regardless of ATK, even at ATK 1, so all skill amp. Milk is also a fixed straw target but still runs ATK%.

sources.title: 애들아 샤르도네 공격력 신경 안써도 된다
sources.titleEn: Guys, you don't need to care about Chardonnay's ATK
sources.summaryEn: PSA: Chardonnay's straw is fixed even at ATK 1 because she holds the 탄속 synergy. A commenter jokes he first wrote 다발 (Volley) and was 'half right'.

sources.title: 4t클럽
sources.titleEn: 4T club
sources.summaryEn: 캔디애플 (guild 탄산수맛쿠키, #1 at 26T 283G) posts 3T 966G, Season 7 personal rank 2, team power 3.91G (~1,013배), with Chardonnay Lv.118 in Macaron's slot and Melon Soda Lv.1 in Cherry's slot; fillers 전갈/피노/정전/닼초/메소 all Lv.1. His floor is about 3T. Tiger Lily's 다발 3 reaches Pomegranate only 'sometimes' now; Milk survives the 17 s wipe with 피감 44.7%; 정전 runs 10 skill haste.

sources.title: 석류 빨대 3개아님?
sources.titleEn: Isn't Pomegranate's straw count 3?
sources.summaryEn: The poster sees 4 Pomegranate straws, not 3. Answer: the Volley (다발) synergy raises the count. Straws on Chardonnay and Milk are fixed while the rest shift; explanation: 탄속 holders are fixed, then ATK order, which moves as Milk's ATK buff changes people's ATK.

sources.title: 메모용 딸크 토벌 730배
sources.titleEn: Memo: Strawberry Crepe conquest 730x
sources.summaryEn: TTO (lobby name Poooooman, personal rank 4th) scores 1T 194G at team power 1.62G (~730배) with the Cherry deck minus Macaron and Cherry, plus Chardonnay (10★) and Strawberry Crepe (Lv.50). ATK order 우피브샤치실. Instead of tuning levels he just lowered supports-adjacent cookies so the supports get Pomegranate, and raised Scorpion 10 levels. No move speed. He found Strawberry Crepe scored higher than Melon Soda in brief testing.

sources.title: 토벌 780배
sources.titleEn: Conquest 780x
sources.summaryEn: 우우웅12 posts 2T 756G at team power 3.53G (780배), personal rank 1 (guild board blacked out; the rank-1 avatar is Chardonnay). Same Chardonnay + Melon Soda deck with Scorpion at Lv.60 and the other fillers at Lv.1. ATK order given as 우시피실전; author thinks Tiger Lily can be swapped for something else.

sources.title: 근데 샤르도네 밀치기 저항있어서 정전이 석류에다가 시너지 못줌
sources.titleEn: Chardonnay's Push RES stops Tiger Lily giving Pomegranate the synergy
sources.summaryEn: Claims Chardonnay's Push RES keeps Tiger Lily's synergy off Pomegranate, then says it seems probabilistic. A commenter asks whether Panda Dumpling (lifting further) instead of Candy Shade Pouch would change it.

sources.title: 토벌 이제 정전을 빼냐 마냐 빼고 뭐넣냐 인데
sources.titleEn: Drop Tiger Lily or not, and for what?
sources.summaryEn: Debate on dropping Tiger Lily: only she gives 다발 3, so commenters say she can't go yet; one says try DPS in her slot and you'll feel the ceiling drop immediately.

sources.title: 샤르도네미친놈 토벌1200배찍음ㅋㅋㅋ
sources.titleEn: Chardonnay insane, hit 1200x
sources.summaryEn: Claims 1200배 (no screenshot). Deck: the original deck with Macaron swapped for Chardonnay, Melon Soda (not Cherry).

sources.title: 시커 4성 2T 가까이 찍었네
sources.titleEn: Nearly 2T with a 4★ Seeker
sources.summaryEn: gramPH reports close to 2T at 575배 with a 4★ Seeker and says Strawberry Crepe beats Melon Soda or Cherry. No screenshot.

sources.title: 아니 근데 토벌점수 이정도 차이나면 마카롱 이거 빨간약 아님?
sources.titleEn: With a score gap this big, wasn't Macaron a red pill?
sources.summaryEn: Poster asks how scores doubled if Chardonnay's crit buff equals Macaron's, implying the old 'Macaron line' worldline didn't matter. Replies: leaked data had Chardonnay at 100% crit vs Macaron 120%; scores came from Cheesecake/Milk order; others argue Macaron's buff could never cover all DPS for the whole fight, Cherry's removal and Chardonnay's sub-DPS count, plus four days of growth and today's packages.

sources.title: 오 5초까지 전부생존된다
sources.titleEn: Oh, everyone survives to 5 s
sources.summaryEn: Raising the fillers' levels keeps all 12 alive until 5 s left; the in-battle shot shows 1,713,978,724,627 (1.71T) with 5.833 s on the clock. Fillers: Scorpion 50, Melon Soda 71, Pinot 90, Tiger Lily 80, Dark Choco 61; core at Lv.117. Author: about 9M in-game HP is enough, and Scorpion is set just below Cheesecake's ATK; fillers must stay below the buffers' ATK.

sources.title: 샤르도네 스가 한줄 정도 괜찮지 않을까
sources.titleEn: One skill-haste line on Chardonnay?
sources.summaryEn: gramPH: with 6 skill-haste gear lines Chardonnay sits at 27 skill haste; one rune line would push it past 30. A commenter: two +20 gear pieces also reach 30. Someone who put 5 SSR skill-haste runes on her is told that's too many.

sources.title: 토벌덱 샤르도네로 바꾸고 4.2t 달성
sources.titleEn: Switched to Chardonnay, hit 4.2T
sources.summaryEn: 저장용 scores 4,227,877,443,138 (4.23T) at team power 4.55G (929배): the old deck with Macaron → Chardonnay (max level) and Cherry → Melon Soda (Lv.1). Less variance than the Cherry deck; he'll switch for stability. His Tiger Lily has only 4 skill haste; Chardonnay runs all skill amp (not complete yet).

sources.title: 샤르도네가 어느정도길래 그럼
sources.titleEn: How strong is Chardonnay, then?
sources.summaryEn: Commenters report their conquest scores before and after Chardonnay: 70G → 200G, 300s → 900s G, 300G → 1T, 330G → 1.2T, 'score tripled', and a new player from 70–80× to 250×. All text, no screens.

sources.title: 와 토벌 미츘네
sources.titleEn: Wow, conquest is crazy now: Candy Shade Pouch with Little Ghost
sources.summaryEn: The poster runs Candy Shade Pouch (lift resistance) with Little Ghost (push resistance) and reports a large jump. A commenter warns that Chardonnay already gives Push RES and that more of it stops Pomegranate getting Tiger Lily's 다발 3.

sources.title: 샤르도네 올스가 맞음 ?
sources.titleEn: All skill haste on Chardonnay?
sources.summaryEn: Asks if Chardonnay should go all skill haste. Majority: all skill amp, which reportedly raises her crit buff amount; one commenter says all haste so she hits every 2 s. Her skill cycles every 4 s and lasts 5 s. Images are reaction stickers.

sources.title: 토벌 체리 자리 고민이네
sources.titleEn: Torn on Cherry's conquest slot
sources.summaryEn: Cherry-slot options Melon Soda / Popcorn / Strawberry Crepe: in a few runs Popcorn ≥ Melon Soda > Strawberry Crepe. Melon Soda has more potential but less stability; Popcorn is more stable.

sources.title: 토벌 장비 이거맞음?
sources.titleEn: Is this the right conquest gear?
sources.summaryEn: Proposed conquest gear: top-left 스증/치확, bottom-left 피감/치저, top-right 스가/스증, bottom-right 스가/피감. Advice: swap 치저 for 체력 and 치확 for 치피 (small difference); crit rate 60 ≈ crit dmg 45; said to be the former #1 (foreign) conquest player's setup.

sources.title: 토벌 전갈 메소 등 1렙 주던 애들 렙 주려는데 질문
sources.titleEn: Levelling the Lv.1 fillers (Scorpion, Melon Soda…)
sources.summaryEn: Levelling fillers raises their ATK; can they steal Pomegranate's straw mid-fight? They need at least Lv.60–70 not to die. Answers: if one steals it, retry. 언담: a 1-point ATK edge usually wins the straw, but the closer the ATK values the more often it gets stolen; many tries fix it.

sources.title: 토벌 8T는 뭐냐 사르도네 그정도임?
sources.titleEn: What's this 8T in conquest? Is Chardonnay that good?
sources.summaryEn: Poster marvels at an '8T' conquest figure (unclear whether a guild or personal score; 83515's board shows guild 다이노사워 at 8T 176G). 언담: it's the same 120% crit rate (as Macaron).

sources.title: 이제 17초 쿵에 다 사노
sources.titleEn: Now everyone survives the 17 s slam

sources.title: 토벌 기록 621배 멍청도식
sources.titleEn: Conquest record 621x, the dumb-simple way
sources.summaryEn: 1T 710G at 2.75G team power (~621배), personal rank 37th, Season 7 with 3d10h left. Chardonnay deck at Lv.117 core with Lv.1 Scorpion, Pinot, Tiger Lily, Dark Choco and Melon Soda. Author ignored ATK order entirely, only lowered levels, and has no move-speed runes.

sources.title: 샤르도네덱으로 토벌 1000배 쳤우..
sources.titleEn: Hit 1000x in conquest with the Chardonnay deck
sources.summaryEn: 저장용: 4T 300G at 4.29G team power (~1000배), personal rank 1st, Chardonnay deck with Pomegranate deliberately Lv.1 to cut team power (Pomegranate's level doesn't change its buff and it deals no damage). Cherry deck peaked ~3T for him. ATK order: Milk and Chardonnay always get Pomegranate's straw first via 탄속 synergy; then Seeker, Skating, Tea Knight, Cheesecake; Scorpion 7th as a straw sink; order within the top 6 barely matters now. Lv.40 fillers because Lv.1s die at 17 s; Pinot and Pomegranate survive at Lv.1. No move speed or Cherry needed.

sources.title: 토벌 실론치즈 공순서 어캐함?
sources.titleEn: Tea Knight vs Cheesecake ATK order in conquest?
sources.summaryEn: 저장용 explains Pomegranate's straws: 3 base straws plus 3 more from Tiger Lily's buff, so ATK ranks split into 1-2-3 (buffed immediately) and 4-5-6 (buffed after a short delay); order inside each group doesn't matter. Milk and Chardonnay take ranks 1 and 2 via 탄속 synergy; long fights make the order mostly irrelevant now.

sources.title: 샤르 9성아니면 토벌 못쓴다고?

sources.title: 토벌은 깡공이 맞는 듯?
sources.titleEn: Flat ATK seems right for conquest?

Concludes flat ATK is better. Reply: mix stats evenly.

sources.title: 다발버프 어케동작하는거임?
sources.titleEn: How does the volley buff work?
sources.summaryEn: Asks whether volley buffs overwrite (Cheesecake 1, Chardonnay 2, Tiger Lily 3) and whether Tiger Lily is worth a slot for 2→3. 저장용: Tiger Lily is the core of conquest; he tried other dealers and came back to Tiger Lily. The main buffers are Milk, Cheesecake, Skating, Chardonnay, Tea Knight and Pomegranate; Pomegranate can't buff itself, so the five others plus Seeker must all receive straws. Base straws 3, with 다발2 only 5, so one misses; 다발3 from Tiger Lily gives 6. A buffer's skill amp adds more than a sub-dealer would.

sources.title: 정글전사와 석류맛쿠키의 슈가룬 필수 세팅
sources.titleEn: Mandatory sugar-rune setup for Jungle Warrior and Pomegranate
sources.summaryEn: Mechanics analysis with skill-card screenshots. Jungle Warrior's transform gives 다발 (multi-shot) synergy +3 to nearby allies, and Pomegranate's beam count scales with 다발 synergy. Both skills have a 10 s cooldown. Pomegranate casts first and is too far from Jungle Warrior to receive the first transform's +3, so her second cast gets only Herb's +2 (5 beams). The author therefore gives Jungle Warrior 2–3 more skill-haste lines than Pomegranate, so Jungle Warrior casts first from the second cycle onward. Pomegranate should be all skill amp.

Milk is leader, the perk is the all-cookie 2% welfare package Lv2, and pets are 갓방울, Hotdog and Panda. The author set a new best about once every 5 tries. Runes are shown for Melon Soda, Rye, Scorpion (accuracy and focus, the old stage build), Bright Seeker (low star) and Milk (ATK plus skill haste), and Dark Choco (haste plus focus). Jungle Warrior is used over Milky for Scorpion's 다발 synergy, and Hotdog beat the multi-hit pet on average.

sources.summaryEn: The Cheesecake lottery deck (로또덱), which the author calls the absolute ceiling above the Rye-Melon and Scorpion-Melon decks. You need a run where Cheesecake gives her ATK buff only to Milk and Scorpion. That can take hundreds to tens of thousands of retries; the author played 4,230 runs that season. Pomegranate's targets follow ATK order: Milk > 피겨 > Scorpion (Macaron) > Bright Seeker > Melon > Macaron. She hits 3 targets at first and 6 after one cycle, so whether Macaron gets the first beam swings damage a lot. The post includes full rune screenshots for 10 cookies and a gear preset named SH/CD/SA. The author ended at 26G 160M on 300.39M (about 87x) and says 100–200x is typical and 300x is possible with good fundamentals.
