takeaways.text: Since 10-08 the meta is the Chardonnay deck: the Cherry deck with Chardonnay for Macaron and Melon Soda for Cherry.
takeaways.detail: 4T 300G at 4.29G (≈1000×) and 4T 227G at 4.55G from one poster whose Cherry ceiling was about 3T (Lv.118 vs Lv.100). The Cherry and Melon Soda decks are obsolete.

takeaways.text: Chardonnay's line crit buff reaches the carries wherever they stand: no Cherry, no move speed.
takeaways.detail: Crit buffs don't stack, so she replaces Macaron outright. Below 9★ one head-to-head still favoured a 9★ Macaron; posters' 5★ wins are unpaired.

takeaways.text: Milk and Chardonnay take Pomegranate's beams first through 탄속, at any ATK; the other four go by ATK order.
takeaways.detail: Brightseeker, Skating Queen, Tea Knight and Cheesecake fill the rest; Scorpion holds 7th. Tiger Lily stays for the sixth beam.

takeaways.text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Chardonnay, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Cheesecake, Tea Knight all skill amp; Brightseeker and Dark Choco haste.
takeaways.detail: Chardonnay's crit buff scales with skill amp; only her Push RES doesn't.

takeaways.text: Raid gear: weapons skill amp + crit, top-right haste + skill amp, armour DR + HP, bottom-right haste + DR. No move speed, accuracy or focus.
takeaways.detail: Season 7 posters split on crit rate, crit dmg or flat ATK beside skill amp on weapons.

takeaways.text: At Lv.114–118 the 17 s wipe is survivable: 서신우's 2.5T run keeps all twelve alive past it.
takeaways.detail: Lv.1 fillers at 9.2M in-game HP survive, stated; fillers levelled to 40–90 live to the last seconds. Level 120 waits on account level 200.

takeaways.text: Season 7's live #1 is at 10T 266G after a day; the top-10 teams are still unpublished.
takeaways.detail: Players on both boards are at 1.2–2.7× their Season 6 finals, median 1.84×, before the season ends. Season 6's #1 isn't in the top 100.

takeaways.text: Among the top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
takeaways.detail: Season 6: score ÷ account power runs 76–164× (median 110×), and the top-power account (50.8G) placed #19. Account-wide, so not the forum's 배.

takeaways.text: Expect retries: the main roll now is Pomegranate catching Tiger Lily's 다발 3 past Chardonnay's Push RES.
takeaways.detail: Before the patch a levelled-filler Cherry account at 2.93G got 208–783× over 100 runs. A 1000× Chardonnay account reports a floor near 3T.

takeaways.text: Built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola is the strongest Arena deck: from Bari 7★ it usually beats Rye at equal spec.
takeaways.detail: Not always: Angel and Rockstar Rye decks are reported beating 8–10★ Bari. Order: set Bari > set Rye >>> plain Bari > plain Rye.

takeaways.text: The Rye deck is the value pick: it beats Bari up to about 6★ and any unset Bari deck.
takeaways.detail: Under 5★ a Bari deck is 'a junk deck' against Rye.

takeaways.text: Most-run Arena lineup: the Rye / Skating Queen / Grapevine deck, 13.0% of crumb.gg's sample.
takeaways.detail: Grouped: Rye builds 31%, the Rumble standard 12 24%, the old five-ranged deck 15% and falling.

takeaways.text: Rye deck flex: Rockstar. Its shield lands inside Bari's first dive.
takeaways.detail: One mirror report has the Rockstar version beat Skating + Grapevine. Angel for Herb is disputed.

takeaways.text: Six Skill Haste lines are out: Bari decks run none, Rye decks three.
takeaways.detail: Rye decks swap bottom-right haste for DR + crit RES and survive the opening.

takeaways.text: Defenses keep losing to equal attackers: attack late before the 00:00 settlement.
takeaways.detail: Cause unknown. The 10-08 patch only adds help text on merc perks.

takeaways.text: Keep an accuracy preset: evasion decks beat unprepared attackers at half their power.
Captain Milk at merc Lv.4 with Armor Repair + Passion Pay; keep Milk ATK #1.
takeaways.detail: Armor Repair needs three tanks.

takeaways.text: Re-check after 10-08: the Lv.120 cap counts in Arena, and Chardonnay is new.
The standard 12 still holds the top 100 on Season 1's last day.
takeaways.detail: 9 of the 12 fully revealed top-100 teams are exactly it.

takeaways.text: Herb shows less often in the top 10; hidden slots hide what replaced her.
takeaways.detail: Herb fell from 67 to 44 top-100 slots. Rockstar shows once in the top 10 (#3).

takeaways.text: Third pet is moving from Hot Doggie to Icy Birdie.
takeaways.detail: Icy Birdie rose from 12 to 45 in the top 100.

takeaways.text: Rye decks win mid-ladder, even 12M down, but lose to finished Bari at the top.
From about 10th to 50th, half the Bari decks reportedly run Vampire for Cherry Cola.
Carry two accuracy lines or the stage preset: evasion defenses spread higher up.
Above 2,000 points, 2–3 defenders are hidden: read the visible core and assume the standard 12.
Season 2 opens 10-08 with an unannounced buff. The Charge buff carries Bari and Oven.
Top-100 rewards need 3,000 points; ranks 101 to ~2,300 share Elite Master 1 rewards.
The power gate is a step table: 35% of damage from 40% of recommended power, 15% from 20%.
Since the 2026-09-23 easing, the 35% bracket clears every main stage to 328-30; the 35% line there is 4.00G.
takeaways.detail: Screenshots: 328-30 GingerCraven at 4.00G, 312-30 at 2.74G, 288-19 at 1.77G, 266-30 Cool Mint on auto at 1.17G.

takeaways.text: On main stages, 15% works on mob stages and Cool Mint; GingerCraven, the bikers and the Redberry packs need 35%.
takeaways.detail: 15% clears: 289-30 Cool Mint at 1.29G (screenshot), 301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G, 271-11 at 971.8M. A 15% GingerCraven run left 41% HP after an hour.

takeaways.text: The cheapest damage is crossing the next bracket line: pad displayed power rather than fight a step lower.
takeaways.detail: Both 15% mob clears sat 0.6M and 4.4M under the 40% line. Pad with a 뻥투 gear preset, SSR power rune lines, and a guild.

takeaways.text: Run the Bari–Cherry Cola charge deck as the general deck and swap per boss slot; the zone cycle tells you which boss is next.
takeaways.detail: Panda Dumpling for launch bosses; Scorpion and Jungle Warrior for GingerCraven; Jungle Warrior or Tiger Lily and Rye for Redberry; Ion and Icy Birdie for the truck.

takeaways.text: Accuracy 900–1,000 is enough after the easing; focus matters for the debuffers.
takeaways.detail: Accuracy caps at 1,203.5 from about chapter 248; ND러너 runs about 1,000 past 300 and calls 1,300 wasted. Dark Choco's shred needs focus.

takeaways.text: In the Rift, every boss but GingerCraven falls at 15%, to about level 18 on screenshots; it stalls by 28 (dc:80706).
takeaways.detail: Park at each GingerCraven until 차원의 힘 reaches its 35% line. Header power only. 15% screenshots: Werehound Princess level 18 (29.73G), Cool Mint 17 (32.97G), trucks 14 (28.76G), Cake Hounds 11 (18.55G).

takeaways.text: 차원의 힘 fills only while idling in the Rift, at the level reached per minute: enter early, it compounds.
takeaways.detail: Recommended power runs from 10.00G at level 1 to about 1,800G at level 100 (season 1); pushers gain about a level a day.

takeaways.text: In the Rift's 15% decks, Milk captains and tops the attack order; mid dealers sit at 77–97, read as level-downs.
takeaways.detail: Milk on top is posted on screen, so both perks land on her. The level-down reading (렙따) is inferred from dc:80625. Decks: rift-15-milk-first-*, rift-15-levelled-rye.

takeaways.text: The Golden Drop stage is Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전): your whole collection vs the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울), scored on damage, ranked per server.
takeaways.detail: One key per run. The top 40 by power deploy; the rest replace the dead. No formation, pets or manual control; up to a minute. No power penalty.

takeaways.text: Top score with a lineup: 578.07G at 14.90G total power (코니, 2026-09-28); a board entry shows 704.63G with no lineup.
Every top run is one engine: Milk captain at top ATK, the beam routed down a set ATK order, a packed formation Milk reaches early.
takeaways.detail: 578G: Milk, Brightseeker, Figure, Scorpion, Macaron, Cheesecake. 379G: Milk, Scorpion, Figure, Brightseeker, Macaron, Melon Soda. 325.9G: Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake.

takeaways.text: Open choice, the beam after Milk: Brightseeker first, then Figure and Scorpion, as in the 578G run.
takeaways.detail: Scorpion second (379G) is now out-scored. ND러너's buffer-first setting (Macaron, Figure) tops out lower; try it only with high-ATK Macaron runes.

takeaways.text: Power sets the scale, not the ranking: the lineup rules are the build.
takeaways.detail: At similar power, scores differ several-fold: 244.7G at 6.62G vs 113.3G at 6.79G; 325.9G at 10.10G vs 127.1G at 10.15G.

takeaways.text: Lineup changes alone move scores.
takeaways.detail: 50-60G to 75.4G with less power shown; 3G to 6G copying ND러너's levels; EOG +42% from benching two strong cookies.

takeaways.text: Leaving cookies out matters as much as bringing them: chargers, summoners and Projectile Speed recipients go to Lv.1. Never use Bari.
takeaways.detail: The Exclusions page lists them with reasons; EOG measured +42% on one account from benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint.

takeaways.text: Cheesecake changed sides on 2026-09-10: excluded while its buff erased Milk's stacks, kept (sixth in ATK) once the stronger stacked buff won.
takeaways.detail: Lime followed the same path in the 379G lineup. Resolved: keep Cheesecake, sixth in ATK; drop it only on a pre-9/10 client.

takeaways.text: Gear is a damage preset, arena or flat-ATK Conquest; a move-speed line helps Milk arrive.
takeaways.detail: No accuracy or focus. The 428.96G run used flat-ATK Conquest gear; a move-speed preset took one account from 50-60G to 75.4G on less power.

takeaways.text: Runs swing by tens of G, so records come from retries.
takeaways.detail: 90-150G on one account, 150-188G for ND러너. Rewards pay the day's and the week's best, so spend every key.

takeaways.text: Breaking the rules costs more than the swing.
takeaways.detail: Records are best-of-many, but the lineup sets the level: Bari in kept one account barely past 100G.

takeaways.text: Power pays only when it crosses a bracket line: near 2.2G each +0.2G moves the 35% reach 3–4 chapters; 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G.
takeaways.detail: 35% reach: 304-19 at 2.2G, 308-5 at 2.4G, 317-8 at 3.0G. Moving from the 55% to the 75% bracket is +36% real damage.

takeaways.text: Stellar Link gives the biggest posted late steps: +13% for opening constellation 8, +10% for its third point.
takeaways.detail: Free pulls open points up to 8-3; 8-3 → 8-6 takes about 45 cookie stars from paid pulls. Stellar Points only reshape open points.

takeaways.text: Guild: free and large, but sized only in account total: leaving cost one player 13G → ~10G (−23%).
takeaways.detail: Joining added +2G total for the same player; another pusher fell to the 15% cut on leaving. Guild lab nodes give element damage and ATK/DEF/HP amplification.

takeaways.text: Plating is steady but slow: ~414 Chocosteel and 43 Syrup per slot to 15; past 15 each step is a 2–12% roll with shatter risk.
takeaways.detail: One 14→15 step gave about +1.5% at 1.6G, for ~₩14,700 (1.5 plating packs) or ~4 days of free Chocosteel.

takeaways.text: From 10-08, cookie levels 101–120 are the next free lever: +64% base stats at 120 (inferred), ~+25% power at 119 (claimed).
takeaways.detail: Levels 79–100 get ~75% cheaper and excess EXP is refunded; bank EXP. A client leak said 150; the notes say 120.

takeaways.text: Resolve and cookie levels are early-game power; late they barely move the number (until the 10-08 cap raise).
takeaways.detail: Early a Resolve level was ~1,000 power; late, +200 levels gave Milk ~1k ATK where one gear line gave 6k. Bank coin chests for a 35% line.

takeaways.text: Free order at 2.2G (the community's): guild and stage-preset padding (free, unmeasured), Stellar points to 8-3 (posted), then lab, weapon plating, oven, Fame, banked Resolve.
takeaways.detail: The 2G → 4G player credits oven 36, research, Bari 5★, Stellar 8-6. A 4G account: sword 20, bow 19, Resolve 997, Fame 130, lab HP 30%.

takeaways.text: Paid order (the community's; no package has a posted power figure): Ad Removal, Unique gear pack, Crumble Pass, 5.5 membership, weekly dungeon keys; TSSR stars last.
takeaways.detail: Ad Removal and Crumble Pass $4.99 (₩7,500) each; weekly keys $3.99 (₩6,000). A pickup TSSR is ~₩289,000 to 5★, ~₩972,000 to 10★.

takeaways.text: Displayed power is not strength: it weights attack-type cookies and the stats you lack, so pad it for stages and ignore it elsewhere.
takeaways.detail: Swapping a support for an attacker raises power; an item's power falls once a resistance target is met; accuracy past ~1,000 adds little.

takeaways.text: Plating and TSSR stars aren't the one road to 4G, and neither ranks above Stellar per won.
takeaways.detail: The 2G → 4G player has no plate above 18 ('18 2개가 끝임'); the plating 4G accounts also sit at Stellar 8-5 to 8-6 and Resolve ~1,000.

takeaways.text: Stellar: stop at 95% (10 points) or 91% (8 points), not 100%.
takeaways.detail: 100% on an old constellation costs 150,000+ Stellar Points expected.

takeaways.text: Plating: keep Syrup for shatter restores, not shatter mitigation, until about plate 18.
takeaways.detail: At 18 the unmitigated shatter is 8%.

takeaways.text: EXP full auto: Brightseeker deals alone, the rest heal, shield and tank; 746 cleared with no input on 10-04.
takeaways.detail: Milk captain, Armor Repair plus Health Insurance, Furball Pup as the Projectile Speed pet. Same lineup cleared 724 with Hot Doggie.

takeaways.text: Retrying is the method: auto decks lose often to the opening and clear on reruns.
takeaways.detail: Whether a lost run returns its key is not stated anywhere captured.

takeaways.text: 770 fell on 10-07: EXP reportedly on auto with endless retries, coin and dough by hand; posted full-auto decks stop lower.
takeaways.detail: The EXP method is an anonymous "ㅇㅇ" reply under the 770 boards, likely the poster but not shown to be. Its lineup isn't posted.

takeaways.text: Bring the boss's weakness element; every boss and element is fixed.
takeaways.detail: Each dungeon tab shows its boss's weakness; 타마타마's element decks stack it and run mostly hands-off.

takeaways.text: Rune crystal is the easiest to automate; dough and EXP need hands past the 600s.
10-08 update eases EXP, dough and research stone; coin and rune unchanged; no cap raise.
takeaways.detail: EXP: lower boss ATK, slower push AoE, smaller inner-book range. Walls reported on 10-07 should soften.

takeaways.text: Sweep once stuck: first-clear rewards are why players push before sweeping.

recommendations.summary: Swap Macaron for Chardonnay and Cherry for Melon Soda. At the Chardonnay deck's 640–1000×, 2.2G makes about 1.4–2.2T.
changes: Chardonnay in Macaron's slot, max level, all skill-amp runes; aim for 9–10★.
Melon Soda Lv.1 in Cherry's slot, no move speed; or Strawberry Crepe Lv.50.
Keep Tiger Lily for the sixth beam; restart runs where Pomegranate misses her 다발 3.
Milk, Chardonnay, Brightseeker, Skating Queen, Tea Knight, Cheesecake at max level; Scorpion 7th in ATK.
Brightseeker to 10★ and her in-battle haste in the 40–50 band.
Once carries hold about 9M+ in-game HP (Season 7, Lv.114–118), level fillers under the 6th recipient's ATK so they outlive the 17 s wipe.

recommendations.summary: Run built Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in both modes; keep Rye Rockstar for sub-7★ Bari; re-check after 10-08.
changes: Get Bari to 7–8★ for regular Arena; under that, the Rye deck usually wins.
Bari gear: no Skill Haste. Skill AMP + crit rate up top, DR + crit RES below.
Rye gear: three Skill Haste lines, top-right only; DR + crit RES bottom-right.
Rye deck flex: Rockstar. Skating Queen beside it.
Captain Milk, merc Lv.4, Armor Repair + Passion Pay; Milk ATK #1.
Rumble: consider Icy Birdie for Hot Doggie; half the top 10 run it.
Keep an accuracy preset for evasion defenders.
Attack late before the 00:00 settlement: defenses lose to equal attackers.
Level to 120 after 10-08: level counts in Arena.
Re-check the Rumble team when Season 2's buff shows: it may drop the Charge buff.

recommendations.summary: Push at 35% with the Bari–Cherry Cola–Brightseeker deck, swapping per boss slot; use 15% only on mob stages; pad power across the next line before a boss.
changes: Build a stage gear preset rolled for power (accuracy about 1,000) and a Skill Haste preset for auto; switch to power just under a line.
Keep SSR sugar-rune lines that add power (crit resist included) until you reach the Rift, then re-roll.
Keep Panda Dumpling for launch bosses, and Scorpion or Jungle Warrior for the ruined-city and snowfield -30s.
Find your 40% and 20% lines in stage-chapters.json: push at 35% to the 40% line, then only mob stages until the next.
At about 2.2G on a stage preset: 55% reaches 288-3, 35% reaches 304-19, 15% covers every stage to 328-30 (from the game data).
Reach 328-30 (4.00G for 35%) early: the Rift's 차원의 힘 grows only while you are in it, and early entrants compound.
In the Rift, read your bracket off the header power, never the formation screen: 15% from 20% of the level's recommended power.
Push every boss but GingerCraven at 15%, to about level 18 on screenshots (stalls by 28, dc:80706); park at GingerCraven for 35%.
In the 15% Rift decks, make Milk captain and top of the attack order; mid dealers sit at 77–97, read as level-downs (inferred).
From 10-08: season 2 asks about 1.45× the power per level and level 120 lifts every preset; re-read the brackets then.

recommendations.summary: Won in the lineup screen: Milk captain at top displayed ATK, Brightseeker then Figure on the beam, beam thieves out, Milk arriving early. Then retry.
changes: Captain Milk at the top ATK the cookie window shows (without the captain's +10%, per one tester in dc:78378); perks Passion Pay plus Rapid Promotion or Like A Family.
Set the ATK order by lowering dealers' levels: Milk, Brightseeker, Figure, Scorpion, Macaron, Cheesecake (the 578G order).
The rest of the 40 only need more power than the excluded cookies.
Level every cookie on the Exclusions page to Lv.1, Bari included; the 578G author also leaves Espresso out.
If Milk walks in late, lower Pomegranate toward Lv.60 (still inside the 40) and drop spare supports.
Use a damage preset, arena (no accuracy or focus) or flat-ATK Conquest, and try one move-speed line if Milk arrives late.
Run at least once a day: the daily board pays only on days with a run, and the weekly board keeps only the best.

recommendations.summary: At 2.2G your 35% reach is 304-19. Best posted lever: constellation-8 Stellar points (+10%), free to 8-3. From 10-08, levels 101–120.
changes: Stay in a guild with research: leaving cost one player ~23% of account total (13G → ~10G); team power not posted.
Keep a stage preset rolled for displayed power (crit resistance, SSR rune lines that add power); swap to it within a few % of a line (unmeasured).
Open and shape constellation-8 points up to 8-3: one step was worth +10% at 2G, about 304-19 → 308 at 35%.
Points past 8-3 need about 45 cookie stars from paid pulls.
Bank cookie EXP: from 10-08 levels go to 120 (+64% base stats, inferred; ~+25% power claimed at 119).
Put Gnome Lab stones into HP 30% and the lower ATK nodes before ATK 30% (~50M stones); the 2G → 4G player credits research most.
Plate the sword and bow toward 20 with Syrup for protection and restores; expect 2% per try at 19→20.
If spending on Stellar Points, use them to shape points that are open; don't chase 100% (95% is the practical end).

recommendations.summary: Run EXP on the solo-Brightseeker deck with the Projectile Speed pet, retry until it clears; sweep each dungeon at your wall.
changes: EXP: Brightseeker, Pomegranate, Lime, Milk (captain), Ion, Dark Choco / Cheesecake, Grapevine, Rockstar, Hound, Herb, Moon Rabbit.
Pets Furball Pup, King Choco Drop, Icy Birdie; perks Armor Repair + Health Insurance.
Below a 10★ Brightseeker or about 4G, expect retries; a Conquest gear preset steadies it.
Other dungeons: stack the boss's weakness element; rune crystal runs on full auto longest.
Push for first-clear rewards, then sweep.

fightEvents.detail: Guild Conquest fight lasts 60 s total, confirmed independently by crumb.gg's DPS chart page ('Fight length 60 s', evidence/15-crumbgg/32-dps-read.txt) and by a datamine poster ('토벌전이 60초', dc:71383). The in-run HUD timer counts down from 60 to 0 (dc:69724, prior evidence); '17초' and '30초' in community shorthand are both remaining-time marks, i.e. elapsed 43 s and elapsed 30 s respectively.

Team runs in from starting positions and collides into a line; there is no scripted stop point; a cookie keeps advancing until physically blocked by an ally or the boss, so leftover move-speed stats or missing backline units change where the line settles (dc:72759, dc:74804; prior evidence dc:60340, dc:64839).

Per an unverified single-author datamine (dc:67285, refined in dc:71383): boss damage reduction is 0% and boss ATK is at its base value (5000) for the first 10 s. This is the highest-damage-efficiency window of the fight, before the boss starts scaling up its own mitigation and offense.
Datamine claim: boss DR steps to 10% and boss ATK jumps to 505,000 at 10 s elapsed. DEF stays fixed at 2000 throughout (matches the independent DEF figure in dc:67299 by the same author).
Datamine claim: DR steps to 30%, boss ATK to 2,500,500.

A distinct sub-event around 27 s remaining, separate from the 30 s slam: thrown mobs ('쫄') self-destruct near the front line. A fully-built (Lv.100) Dark Choco was reported dying to this specifically, while a Lv.1 Dark Choco instead died to the 30 s slam itself (dc:71219); matches the '3 bomb mobs thrown at the front line' step of the previously-recorded 30 s sequence (dc:53667, prior evidence).

The '30 s slam' ('30초 쿵'/'30초 내려찍기'/'부랄찢기'): the boss's first major team-wide hit. Prior evidence (dc:53667) describes the full sequence as gift-bomb -> ground pounds -> 3 bomb-mobs thrown at the front line -> jump. This batch adds concrete HP survival floors (~3-4M HP generally, front row ~4.5M / back row ~3.5M as a more granular split) and a team-power curve (~400M power = 1-2 survivors, ~600M = full survival, ~1.5G = never dies here). It is RNG-sensitive even at fixed power/build (one account cleared it on a 3rd retry after 2 failures at identical build). Milk is disproportionately likely to die here because she is healing others during this window without being healed herself, which then removes her ATK buff for the remainder of the fight.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 50%, boss ATK to 12,500,500. This bracket covers the 30 s slam window through the run-up to the 17 s wipe.

Cookies begin dying individually starting around 19 s remaining (elapsed ~41 s) — the wipe is a taper, not a single simultaneous kill. Dead cookies remain visible in the formation UI with a greyed portrait and an hourglass badge rather than disappearing; no evidence of in-run revival was found (searches for '부활' turned up only unrelated gacha-cookie discussion).

The '17 s super-jump' (elapsed 43 s): historically a certain full-team wipe ('확정전멸') for every publicly documented run through at least late September, including runs at 2.2G team power (dc:69250) and the #1 guild's own 827G video (prior evidence). The first credible survival reports appear only at very high account power (~21G, dc:76583, prior evidence), and only for 4 of 12 cookies (Macaron/Brightseeker/Pomegranate/Skating Queen), who then keep dealing damage until about 8 s remain. This remains a timing correlation with the Season 5 score jump, not a shown, replicated build.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 70%, boss ATK to 250,005,000.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 90%, boss ATK to 750,005,000, for the final ~2 s of the fight.

The 60 s timer, not a team wipe, ends the fight and locks the score. A team that wipes completely well before 60 s still keeps whatever damage it dealt before dying (a full wipe at the 30 s slam still scored >100x in one report) — there is no bonus or penalty tied to surviving to the buzzer beyond the extra damage window that survival buys.

The datamine's implied 7th stage (99% DR, boss ATK 1,562,505,000, which would start at elapsed 70 s) is never reached inside a 60 s fight. The original poster has no explanation for why the data table extends past the fight's own time limit — flagged as an open question for a client datamine (is there an unused 'overtime' mode, or is this a leftover/placeholder stage).

counters.conditions: Bari 7★+ at similar spec, or a clear spec lead.
counters.why: The dive deletes Milk and Rye within seconds; Arena has no +30% DR to blunt it.

counters.conditions: Bari 6★ or less, or an unset Bari deck. Under 5★ Bari is 'a junk deck'.
counters.why: If the dive doesn't kill, the Bari deck has no sustain and Rye wins the long fight.

counters.conditions: A fully set Bari deck: one player lost it over about 50 fights.
counters.why: The faster shield still can't hold a finished dive.

counters.conditions: Rye mirror; one player's report.
counters.why: The Skating + Grapevine version beat Bari decks but lost to the Rockstar one.

counters.conditions: An attacker with no accuracy: 14.38M beat 27.35M.
counters.why: If the evasion deck survives the dive's first turn, it wins; lose one or two cookies and it folds.

counters.conditions: Theory and anecdotes only; no result exists.
counters.why: Crepe pushes Moon Rabbit before its debuff; Espresso launches Rye.

counters.conditions: Stated by the deck's proposers; no result shown.
counters.why: Soul Guidance makes the chargers immune to push and lift.

counters.conditions: Bari under 5★, so Soul Guidance covers one charger.
counters.why: Not explained; plausibly the unwrapped chargers get pushed out (inference).

counters.conditions: 17.59M Chain defense against a 17–18M Rye deck: 3 losses of 3.
counters.why: A decoy soaks Rye's first volley; spread damage takes her supports apart.

counters.conditions: The Seeker version lost at about 2M more power.
counters.why: Grapevine is a second healer; Seeker's drones vanish when their target dies.

counters.conditions: Only on an accuracy preset: one accuracy line breaks it, even from far weaker teams.
counters.why: Accuracy cancels evasion. The edge is the gear, not the lineup.

counters.conditions: Even at 1★ Bari and twice the power in launch week.
counters.why: The chargers reach the back line and kill the carries and Milk on contact.

counters.conditions: Across a 3–4M power deficit (pre-Bari).
counters.why: Every buff on one piercing carry beats buffs spread over several.

counters.conditions: Even with the ranged side 3–4M stronger; works with Bari at 2–3★.
counters.why: Chargers with +30% HP reach the back-line carries first.

counters.conditions: One win on video: 18.67M with a 1★ Bari against 15.35M.
counters.why: Bari (1.58M) and Oven (1.21M) out-damaged every ranged carry.

counters.conditions: Mid-ladder at similar power; wins reported up to +6M and once at −8M.
counters.why: Rumble's +30% DR lets the tanks survive the dive; then Rye out-damages.

counters.conditions: At the very top, against finished high-star Bari. Rye is on 2 of the top 100 (10-07).
counters.why: Buffed divers kill the back line on contact, before tanks and heals matter.

counters.conditions: Mid-ladder, even 12M down: 20.86M beat 32.27M.
counters.why: Rockstar's shield and the DR buff absorb the dive; Rye and Hound finish it.

counters.conditions: At the top: a commenter caps it near 200th; finished Bari wins higher up.
counters.why: High-star divers kill before the shield cycles.

counters.conditions: Held 3 standard-12 attacks above 2,000 points (254th, 23.85M).
counters.why: The team survives the opening; Rye and Chain-buffed Pinot win the long fight.

counters.conditions: Above 3,000 points, when the enemy chargers run no Skill Haste: 9 standard-12 attackers failed.
counters.why: Enemy chargers chase the decoy Oven and clump for Crepe and Rye.

counters.conditions: The decoy deck's one loss in 11 defenses above 3,000.
counters.why: Not explained; Vampire's accuracy-down and the evasion pets are the difference (inference).

counters.conditions: One player on day 1, winning 2M down.
counters.why: Crepe pushes the enemy front together for Bari and Cherry Cola (disputed).

counters.conditions: Lost to every Rye deck met, including one 2M weaker.
counters.why: Moon Rabbit and Ion hold the charge wave while Rye shoots.

counters.conditions: Any early-sweep Bari deck; 'catastrophic' with Bari 5★+ and Oven.
counters.why: The charge burst wipes it before Wizard gets going.

counters.conditions: Near-certain from equal power to +3M for the ranged side.
counters.why: Wizard's area damage wins once the fight passes about 10 s.

counters.conditions: Only against a mediocre-spec Bari side; a warning, not shown.
counters.why: The +30% DR blunts the burst, and a surviving Rapid Fire deck wins.

counters.conditions: One player's attack rotation; no result shown.
counters.why: Not explained.

counters.conditions: 8.41M with 1,005 evasion beat 16.53M with 950 accuracy. Disputed.
counters.why: Attacks miss; Vampire cuts accuracy further. Hidden names stop scouting.

powerSources.costPerRoll: 10 SP unlocked; 10/30/60/100/150/220 SP with 1–6 points locked (web:sugarpocket-stella)
powerSources.cap: up to 12 points per constellation, 100% area; constellation 8 is still the frontier in October. A point opens every 15 cookie stars: constellation 8 at 660, 8-5 at 690, 8-6 at 705 (dc:81196, dc:78964, dc:78814, dc:77737)
powerSources.diminishing: Constellation 8 pays 1.3% amplification per 1% of area (1.0 on 7; dc:78814, dc:78964). Area per SP falls fast: 91% (8 points) ≈ 1,900 SP, 95% (10) ≈ 5,280–7,900, 100% (12) ≈ 150,000–400,000 (dc:68586, dc:56417, nv:43444, dc:73840, web:yt-mL9MSX3QD94). New points need ever more cookie stars (dc:76290).

spendingSteps.step: Level the lineup (free resets), Milk first.
Spend gold on Resolve, ATK first.
spendingSteps.why: Early each level is a big share of power; a new player more than doubled power with Resolve, Stellar and gear.

spendingSteps.step: Pull pickups to 5★; Crystals on cookies, not pets.
spendingSteps.why: Stars open Stellar points; pets don't.

spendingSteps.step: Stellar Link: unlocked 10-SP rolls to 60–70%.
Oven: open dough; mileage buys dough keys first.
Gnome Lab one step per node up to the specials; join a guild.
spendingSteps.why: Specials (Sugar Flame, dice) speed everything; guild help and guild lab.

spendingSteps.step: Plating: all to 5, then all to 10.
Arena every day for Fame.
Ad Removal (7,500 KRW / $4.99).
Unique 3-piece gear pack at oven 10 (6,000 KRW).
Crumble Pass (7,500 KRW / $4.99).
5.5 permanent membership (55,000 KRW) if staying 2+ months.
Cake Hound packs (1,500 / 12,000) and the monthly memberships.
Oven levels and gear (600M–1G is 'mostly oven-level gear').
spendingSteps.why: The main driver in this band.

spendingSteps.step: Plating to 15 with free Chocosteel (24 a day) and exchange Syrup; sword, bow, staff first.
spendingSteps.why: At 150M with 15/13/13 plates, plates were the advised next step.

spendingSteps.step: Stellar: hexagon at 6 points, octagon 91% at 8 (~1,900 SP).
Gnome Lab HP and ATK nodes; defense last.
Bank coin chests; open when a 35% line fails.
Exchanges: Syrup Metal > Chocosteel > Stellar > the rest; guild shop Tea Knight first.
Weekly daily dungeon key set (6,000 KRW / $3.99) while floors are open.
spendingSteps.why: Dungeon floors drive oven, coins, stones, runes.

spendingSteps.step: Monthly gacha membership (15,000) with the 5.5 for pickups to 7–8★.
Stage pass tiers after 168.
Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 (32,000) for 80%+.
spendingSteps.why: The creator's pick for taking every open constellation to 80%+; it shapes open points, it doesn't open new ones.

spendingSteps.step: Stellar: open constellation 7–8 points (stars) and shape them; 95% at 10 points on constellation 7.
Plating: weapons toward 15 then 20; Syrup for protection and restores.
Gnome Lab upper nodes (millions of stones).
Pure-power stage preset near a line; accuracy/focus ~900–1,000 is enough after the easing.
Fame daily.
Plate thanks pack (9,900: 70 Chocosteel + 30 Syrup).
Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 or Vol.2.
Arena tickets for Fame.
Check your guild's research level: a research-13 guild is claimed at ~+20% account total power; leaving a guild dropped a pusher to the 15% cut.
spendingSteps.basisNote: claimed for team power; posted only in account total (13G → ~10G on leaving, dc:81826)
spendingSteps.why: Free to check; leaving cost one player ~23% of account total.

spendingSteps.step: Build a pure-power stage preset (crit resistance and other padding lines, SSR rune lines that add power) and swap to it at a line.
Stellar: open and shape constellation-8 points up to 8-3, which free pulls reach; points past 8-3 (about 45 cookie stars to 8-6) need paid pulls.
spendingSteps.basisNote: posted gain (+10% for the third point at 2G); reach inferred

spendingSteps.step: Gnome Lab: HP 30% and the lower ATK nodes before ATK 30% (~50M stones).
spendingSteps.basisNote: community order; the 2G → 4G reply credits research
spendingSteps.why: 'Padded power is purely research' (dc:76290); special research 19 (ATK 30%) gave +2.3% at 3.4G (dc:82156). From 10-08 a 10-level node (130-1) costs ~1.01G stones (leak).

spendingSteps.step: Plating: sword and bow toward 19–20 (most posted 4G accounts show sword 20–21, bow 19, rest 15).
spendingSteps.basisNote: posted gain near 15 at 1.6G (~+1.5% a step, approximate); community order beyond

spendingSteps.step: Oven levels toward the mid-30s for gear level.
spendingSteps.basisNote: community order; one account's account of its path

spendingSteps.step: Bank cookie EXP for levels 101–120 (cap 120 from 10-08); levels 79–100 get ~75% cheaper and refunded.
spendingSteps.basisNote: community; the gain is inferred (+64% base stats at 120) or claimed (~+25% power at 119)
spendingSteps.why: The next big free lever after 10-08; EXP and Crumble level gate it.

spendingSteps.step: Fame; Resolve only from banked coins to cross a line.
Rumble Special Pass (₩19,000) while it runs.
spendingSteps.why: A Bari pull ticket, Syrup and keys; the gallery calls it great value.

spendingSteps.step: Keep the weekly key set and Crumble Pass running.
spendingSteps.why: Stones for the lab, dough for the oven.

spendingSteps.step: Stellar Link packs to shape points that are already open (not for 100%).
spendingSteps.basisNote: community order; the costs are guide expectations
spendingSteps.why: Once points are open, SP is the cheapest way to add area (~550–1,900 SP expected per shape, nv:5693, dc:55570). It opens no points (dc:76290).

spendingSteps.step: Plate thanks packs for Syrup (all three while sold), weapons first; keep restore Syrup in hand.
spendingSteps.basisNote: posted gain near 15 (approximate) with table costs
spendingSteps.why: About +1.5% per 14→15 step at 1.6G for ~₩14,700 (inferred); most posted 4G accounts have weapon plates at 19–21.

spendingSteps.step: TSSR stars only for Stellar points or a deck need.
spendingSteps.why: About 289,000 KRW for 5★; a blessing-7 player at 3G+ said reaching 328 would take about 3,000,000 KRW more.

spendingSteps.step: Enter the Rift early; Dimensional Energy grows while you are in it and inflates power there (~10G shown).
Re-roll the stage-padding rune lines for damage once in the Rift.
Past 3–4G the levers players name are plating 16+ and TSSR stars; players at 3G+ report nothing cheaper left to raise.

nothing left at 100 until 10-08; then levels 101–120 (gain claimed or inferred)

accountRoadmaps.verdict: A top-3 account. The gaps are setup, not power: Conquest beam order, Dungeon exclusions and the PvP deck choice.

parked.why: GingerCraven never falls at 15%. Idle there for Dimensional Energy; the season ends 10-08.
1.3T coins a level, for power only.
Power isn't damage; rank by damage or score.
About 1 run in 4 misaligns, and it ranks below Cherry.
Only for teams that die at the 30 s slam.
They rank by crystal value, not damage.

unread: Power, PvP, Hit and Evasion gear presets

accountRoadmapItems.action: Reset Pinot, Dark Choco and Tiger Lily to Lv.1 before the season
accountRoadmapItems.why: At Lv.100 their ATK is above Macaron, Tea Knight and Cheesecake, so they take the buffers' beams.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Beams 4–6 go back to the buffers, as in the deck behind the record's 1T 999G.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Free; a reset refunds all EXP. Pinot plays Lv.1 in PvP until re-levelled.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Lower Scorpion until she's exactly 7th in ATK
accountRoadmapItems.why: At Lv.100 (2.63M ATK) she's 4th. Her job is only to catch stray beams.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: One more beam reaches a buffer.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Free, roughly Lv.1–45. The Dungeon wants her high, so re-level her for it.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Check the ATK order in battle before keeping a run
accountRoadmapItems.why: The order must be Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake. Octo Wasabi's +8% doesn't show on the stat screen.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Catches misaligned beams before the run is spent.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Donate gems to finish Light Elemental DMG research 14-2
accountRoadmapItems.why: It's 49% done, and Light covers Milk, Brightseeker, Cheesecake and Tea Knight. The Piñata is weak to Light.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: +10% Elemental DMG for the Conquest carries.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Reset Cool Mint, Licorice, Cream Soda, Shortcake and Lemon to Lv.1
accountRoadmapItems.why: Excluded chargers, summoners and projectile cookies in the top 40 pull Milk away from the dealers.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: One measurement: benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint gave +42%. You score 128G; the meta deck makes 379G.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Free; none of them is in your lineups.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Swap Icy Birdie for King Choco Drop in Rumble defense
accountRoadmapItems.why: Over 95% of top-100 Rumble teams run King Choco Drop. Yours sits unused at 10★.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: +16% max HP for the whole team.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Put Cherry Cola in Doughnut King's slot in Rumble defense
accountRoadmapItems.why: The meta slot r2-5 is the third charger. Vampire is the alternative.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Matches 9 of the 12 fully revealed top-100 teams.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Free. Re-check once Season 2's buff shows.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Test Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in a spare Arena attack lineup
accountRoadmapItems.why: Your Bari is 8★, past the 7★ line where Bari beats Rye at equal spec.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: The record's top Arena deck. You're 4th with the Rye deck.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Spend the banked 31,930 SP on Stellar shuffles
accountRoadmapItems.why: The area is 86%. Each shuffle can raise ATK/DEF/HP amp, which applies in every mode.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: ATK amp above 111.8%. The record's stop lines are 91–95%.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: 150 SP a shuffle, so about 212 shuffles on hand.

accountRoadmapItems.action: At the Lv.120 cap, level Milk first and keep her ATK #1
accountRoadmapItems.why: Every buff order and both ATK perks key off the ATK #1 ally.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: A bigger Milk buff in Conquest, the Dungeon, the Rift and PvP.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: EXP. The 10-08 patch refunds Lv.79–100 EXP, about 10.5M per Lv.100 cookie.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Then level the PvP twelve to 120
accountRoadmapItems.why: Level counts in Arena; Resolve, Stellar, the labs and Fame don't.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: PvP stats at the new cap.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Reroll Milk's four SR ATK lines toward SSR ATK
accountRoadmapItems.why: Her 4.2–4.7 lines could roll 6–7. Milk wants all ATK% in Conquest and the Dungeon.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: About +9–11 points of ATK AMP on the cookie every buff scales from.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Reroll Skating Queen's three low lines to SSR Skill AMP
accountRoadmapItems.why: Her U DR, C ATK and U HP lines add nothing to her buff, which scales with skill amp.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: A stronger skill-amp buff on the beam recipients.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Upgrade Cheesecake's and Pomegranate's SR/R Skill AMP lines to SSR
accountRoadmapItems.why: Cheesecake has 2 SR lines plus 2 junk lines; Pomegranate has 3 SR, 1 R and 1 C.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Stronger buffs from the Volley grant and Pomegranate's beams.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Take Brightseeker to 10★
accountRoadmapItems.why: 10★ opens two rune slots. The 1.62T run used a 10★ Brightseeker.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: More haste or skill amp on the carry; the size of the gain is unmeasured.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Raise Tea Knight from 5★ to 7★ for skill tier IV
accountRoadmapItems.why: She's the only buffer under 9★, and her +70% Boss DMG buff fills a beam slot.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Unmeasured.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Rune Bari for haste and DR; tank Hound, Ion and Oven
accountRoadmapItems.why: Bari wants about 45 haste; yours runs ATK lines. Hound's runes are offensive.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Full Soul Guidance uptime, and PvP tanks that hold.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Rune crystals. Bari's ATK lines also serve the Rift.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Plate the Conquest top-left weapons toward +20
accountRoadmapItems.why: Sub-options rise from +130% at +15 to +200% at +20. Yours are +16 to +17.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Bigger skill-amp and crit DMG lines.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: Chocosteel and Syrup; about 2% a try at 19→20.

accountRoadmapItems.action: In Rift Season 2, run the levelled-Rye setup
accountRoadmapItems.why: Non-dealers at Lv.64–70 stack the ATK-ordered buffs on Brightseeker, Rye and Cherry Cola.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: The record's furthest 15% clear. You run Bari, Crepe and Moon Rabbit instead.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Promote Continuum Cog from 0★ (0/1)
accountRoadmapItems.why: It gives +50% boss DMG in the Rift even at base.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Unmeasured.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Get Chardonnay and test her as the Volley source
accountRoadmapItems.why: Her line buff grants Volley and could take over Tiger Lily's sixth-beam role.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Unmeasured; her numbers are datamined only.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Finish Oven 40
accountRoadmapItems.why: The gear level cap is Oven × 3, so 117 becomes 120. The mission is 39/40.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Higher base stats on new gear, plus 1,000 gems.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Reset Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola only for Dungeon sessions
accountRoadmapItems.why: The Dungeon records exclude them, but they're your PvP core.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Completes the exclusion list.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: PvP defense is weaker while they sit at Lv.1.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Re-pick the Rumble deck once the Season 2 buff shows
accountRoadmapItems.why: Season 1's Charge HP +30% propped up Bari and Oven.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: The defense fits the new passive.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Replace the crit-RES lines on BR2 and BR3 with DR
accountRoadmapItems.why: Crit resistance does nothing against the Conquest boss.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Small; survival only.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Take Bari to 9★ through the pickup counter
accountRoadmapItems.why: The counter is at 3,017 of 3,060, and Bari's strength scales with stars.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: More Bari DR and a shorter cooldown.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Star up King Choco Drop (10★, 1/4)
accountRoadmapItems.why: It's the top Rumble pet; its HP grant grows with stars.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: More team HP in Rumble.

accountRoadmapItems.action: Fame 132, then the Gnome Lab DEF row
accountRoadmapItems.why: Fame's crit DMG goes 86→88. Lab DEF is at 5/7.
accountRoadmapItems.payoff: Small stat gains.
accountRoadmapItems.cost: 190 Fame medals (52 on hand) and lab stones.
